We introduce three progressively stronger capability levels: Plausible models preserve task-relevant temporal, geometric, or physical structure; Controllable models additionally predict how interventions alter that structure; and Actionable models translate predictions into measurable gains in planning, action, learning, evaluation, verification, recovery, or data selection. We complement this hierarchy with a 3 x 4 matrix crossing geometry, physics, and action grounding with improvement loops centered on data, rewards, policies, and the model itself. Using this framework, we survey manipulation, navigation, locomotion, autonomous driving, and general embodied learning, tracing technical progressions, clarifying capability requirements, and examining datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. We identify challenges in long-horizon consistency, uncertainty calibration, causal intervention testing, latency, verification and recovery, and cross-embodiment transfer. This perspective shifts evaluation from visual plausibility toward whether predictions capture task-relevant state, reflect intervention effects, and improve the closed-loop behavior of embodied agents.
summary_zh: 世界模型通过维持隐藏状态、预判后果、比较干预措施，并在执行偏离预期时进行自适应调整，将具身智能中的感知与决策相连接。尽管进展常以视觉逼真度来衡量，但其价值在于改善行为。人在伸手拿杯之前，会预判杯子的重量和抓取阻力，并在接触前调整手型。这种预判是粗略的，很少以图像形式呈现，却能指导行动。这引出一个核心问题：哪些预测能力能够改善行为？现有综述按架构、输出模态或应用领域组织，未明确回答这一问题。我们提出三个递进的能力层级：合理模型保持与任务相关的时间、几何或物理结构；可控模型进一步预测干预如何改变该结构；可行动模型则将预测转化为规划、行动、学习、评估、验证、恢复或数据选择中的可量化收益。我们以3×4矩阵补充这一层级框架，将几何、物理和行为锚定与围绕数据、奖励、策略及模型本身的改进回路交叉对应。基于该框架，我们审视了操作、导航、 locomotion、自动驾驶和通用具身学习领域，梳理技术演进，阐明能力需求，并考察数据集、基准和评估协议。我们识别出长时程一致性、不确定性校准、因果干预测试、延迟、验证与恢复以及跨具身迁移等方面的挑战。这一视角将评估从视觉逼真度转向预测是否捕捉任务相关状态、是否反映干预效果，以及是否改善具身智能体的闭环行为。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework of three capability levels—Plausible, Controllable, and Actionable—to evaluate world models for embodied intelligence, shifting focus from visual fidelity to behavioral benefit, and surveys related work across manipulation, navigation, locomotion, and driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了三个能力层次——合理性、可控性和可操作性——来评估具身智能中的世界模型，将关注点从视觉保真度转向行为收益，并综述了操作、导航、移动和驾驶等相关工作。

title: Weave: Learning Whole-Body Dexterous Loco-Manipulation from Human-Object Interactions
summary: Learning humanoid-object interaction requires coordinating whole-body balance, locomotion, and dexterous hand contact to control both robot and object motion. Human demonstrations provide examples of coordinated interaction, but transferring these behaviors to humanoid robots requires learning how to establish and maintain effective contacts under different embodiments and dynamics. We present Weave, a unified framework for learning whole-body dexterous humanoid-object interaction from captured human demonstrations. Weave first converts captured human-object interactions into executable robot-object references through contact-aware retargeting and approach-motion completion. At its core is a contact- and geometry-aware policy that jointly commands 29 body joints and 12 actuated finger joints across multiple objects and interaction sequences. Evaluation across nine objects yields a 92.5% success rate on trained interactions and, without any additional training, 65.0% on sequences never seen during training. We additionally release ~9,000 physically executed rollouts spanning ~23 hours, providing robot-object trajectories with contact annotations for downstream interaction-policy learning and physically consistent HOI motion generation. Project website: https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Weave/
summary_zh: 学习人形对象交互需要协调全身平衡、运动以及灵巧的手部接触，以同时控制机器人和对象的运动。人类示范提供了协调交互的范例，但将这些行为迁移到人形机器人上，需要学习如何在不同身体形态和动力学条件下建立并维持有效接触。我们提出了Weave，一个统一的框架，用于从采集的人类示范中学习全身灵巧的人形对象交互。Weave首先通过接触感知的重定向和接近动作补全，将采集到的人与对象交互转换为可执行的机器人-对象参考轨迹。其核心是一个接触与几何感知的策略，能够共同控制29个身体关节和12个驱动手指关节，跨越多个对象和交互序列。在九个对象上的评估显示，已训练交互的成功率为92.5%，而在训练中从未见过的序列上，无需额外训练即可达到65.0%的成功率。此外，我们发布了约9000次物理执行的滚动数据，总计约23小时，提供了带有接触标注的机器人-对象轨迹，可用于下游交互策略学习和物理一致的人-对象交互（HOI）运动生成。项目网站：https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Weave/
tldr: Weave is a unified framework that learns whole-body dexterous humanoid-object interaction from captured human demonstrations, using contact-aware retargeting and a contact/geometry-aware policy to command 29 body and 12 finger joints, achieving 92.5% success on trained interactions and 65.0% on unseen sequences, with ~9,000 executed rollouts released.
tldr_zh: Weave是一个统一的框架，通过接触感知重定向和接触/几何感知策略，从捕捉的人类演示中学习全身灵巧人形物体交互，控制29个身体关节和12个手指关节，在训练交互中实现92.5%的成功率，在未见序列上实现65.0%，并发布了约9000次物理执行轨迹。

title: WholeBodyWAM: Generalizing Pre-trained World-Action Priors to Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via WBC-Grounded Coordination
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to general-purpose robot manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. However, most WAM studies focus on tabletop or arm-centric manipulation, while humanoid loco-manipulation remains less explored. To address this gap, we introduce WholeBodyWAM, which jointly predicts future visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents for generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation. It preserves pre-trained world-action priors while grounding heterogeneous whole-body controller (WBC) semantics and coordinating whole-body behavior. Extensive experiments show that WholeBodyWAM achieves an overall simulation task success rate of 91.9%, with a 0.23 improvement in real-world out-of-distribution task progress and a 70% reduction in success-rate variance across WBCs relative to the respective baselines. These results suggest a path toward scalable humanoid whole-body intelligence by extending pre-trained world-action priors through structured WBC grounding and coordination, rather than relearning whole-body behavior from scratch. Project page: https://wholebodywam.github.io/.
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动态与动作，为通用机器人操作提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有WAM研究大多聚焦于桌面或机械臂中心的操作任务，而对人形机器人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）的探索相对不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了WholeBodyWAM，该模型联合预测未来视觉动态、操作动作及全身控制意图，以实现可泛化的人形机器人全身移动操作。它既保留了预训练的世界行动先验知识，又能够锚定异构全身控制器（WBC）的语义信息，并协调全身行为的生成。大量实验表明，WholeBodyWAM在仿真任务中总体成功率达到91.9%，在真实世界分布外任务中任务进度提升0.23，且在不同WBC间的成功率方差相比各基线降低70%。上述结果揭示了一条实现可扩展人形机器人全身智能的路径：通过结构化WBC锚定与协调来扩展预训练的世界行动先验，而非从头重新学习全身行为。项目主页：https://wholebodywam.github.io/。
tldr: WholeBodyWAM extends pre-trained World Action Models to humanoid loco-manipulation by jointly predicting visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents, improving task success and robustness across controllers.
tldr_zh: WholeBodyWAM 将预训练的世界动作模型扩展到人形机器人全身移动操作，通过联合预测视觉动态、操作动作和全身控制意图，提高了任务成功率和对控制器的鲁棒性。

title: SAVLA: Symmetry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become the dominant paradigm for language-conditioned robot manipulation. However, although images and language instructions inherently encode geometric information, VLAs acquire their spatial competence purely from demonstrations. As a result, they are reliable only within the range of scene poses that the demonstrations cover. We propose SAVLA, an end-to-end symmetry-aware VLA model for robust and data-efficient policy learning. Our approach keeps the pretrained vision-language backbone entirely frozen while combining it with an equivariant flow-matching action head and a learned canonicalizer. The head decomposes its state, action, and conditioning inputs into invariant and equivariant channels, and preserves this typing throughout all of its layers. The canonicalizer transforms oblique-view images into a canonical frame and rotates the geometric conditions consistently. We evaluate our model on LIBERO. Compared with the GR00T N1.5 baseline, SAVLA improves the success rate averaged over all four LIBERO suites by 5.1 points and increases the mean success rate under rotation on LIBERO-Goal from 41.5% to 90.4%.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为语言条件机器人操作的主导范式。然而，尽管图像和语言指令内在地编码了几何信息，VLA仅从示范中获取其空间能力。因此，它们仅在示范所覆盖的场景姿态范围内才可靠。我们提出了SAVLA，一种端到端的对称感知VLA模型，用于鲁棒且数据高效的政策学习。我们的方法保持预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络完全冻结，同时将其与等变流匹配动作头和学习的规范化器相结合。该动作头将其状态、动作和条件输入分解为不变通道和等变通道，并在其所有层中保持这种类型划分。规范化器将斜视角图像变换到规范坐标系，并一致地旋转几何条件。我们在LIBERO上评估了我们的模型。与GR00T N1.5基线相比，SAVLA在全部四个LIBERO套件上的平均成功率提高了5.1个百分点，并将LIBERO-Goal在旋转条件下的平均成功率从41.5%提升至90.4%。
tldr: SAVLA proposes a symmetry-aware VLA model for robotic manipulation with a frozen vision-language backbone, equivariant flow-matching action head, and learned canonicalizer, achieving significant improvements in success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SAVLA提出了一种用于机器人操作的对齐对称感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过冻结预训练骨干、等变流匹配动作头和相机规范化器，在LIBERO基准上显著提升成功率及旋转鲁棒性。

title: ProxiDex: Learning Dynamics-Guided Proximity Policy for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Multi-finger dexterous manipulation relies on stable hand-object interactions, yet these interactions are partially observable in practice. Visual observations are often occluded by the hand, tactile sensors introduce hardware-specific modalities and calibration burdens, and existing policies rarely model how these cues evolve under actions, making them brittle under contact uncertainty. To address these, we present ProxiDex, a dynamics-guided proximity policy framework that treats hand-object proximity as an interaction state for dexterous manipulation. ProxiDex reconstructs interaction point clouds and converts geometric distances into proximity cues, forming a hardware-agnostic contact representation that provides immersive feedback during VR teleoperation. Built on this representation, ProxiDex learns action-conditioned proximity dynamics with a coupled forward-inverse design: future observation latents are predicted from actions, while proximity variations are decoded from latent changes. Leveraging these dynamics, ProxiDex adaptively reweights proximity tokens across manipulation phases and uses dynamics-consistency supervision to guide policy inference, stabilizing action generation under unreliable visual feedback. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved success rates and robustness over representative baselines across standard, unseen objects, and perturbation scenarios. Additional visualizations are available at https://proxidex.github.io/.
summary_zh: 多指灵巧操作依赖于稳定的手-物体交互，然而在实际应用中，这些交互仅能部分可观测。视觉观测常被手部遮挡，触觉传感器引入了硬件特定的模态和标定负担，且现有策略很少对这些线索在动作作用下的演变进行建模，导致其在接触不确定性下表现脆弱。为解决上述问题，我们提出了ProxiDex，一种动力学引导的近距策略框架，将手-物体近距视为灵巧操作中的交互状态。ProxiDex重建交互点云，并将几何距离转换为近距线索，从而形成一种与硬件无关的接触表征，可在VR遥操作过程中提供沉浸式反馈。基于该表征，ProxiDex通过耦合的正向-逆向设计学习动作条件下的近距动力学：从动作预测未来观测潜在变量，同时从潜在变量变化中解码近距变化。利用这些动力学信息，ProxiDex在不同操作阶段自适应地对近距令牌进行加权，并使用动力学一致性监督引导策略推理，在不稳定的视觉反馈下稳定动作生成。仿真和真实世界实验表明，在标准物体、未见物体及扰动场景下，相较于代表性基线方法，ProxiDex在成功率和鲁棒性方面均有所提升。更多可视化内容请访问 https://proxidex.github.io/。
tldr: ProxiDex introduces a hardware-agnostic proximity-based interaction representation and learns action-conditioned proximity dynamics to improve dexterous manipulation robustness under partial observability, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: ProxiDex 提出了一种硬件无关的接近度交互表示，并学习动作条件下的接近度动力学，以提高在部分可观测条件下的灵巧操作鲁棒性，并在仿真和真实世界实验中进行了验证。

title: UniDex-ViTac: Learning Unified Visuo-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation Policy from Human Video Data
summary: Human videos provide demonstrations of dexterous manipulation but lack robot-executable actions and tactile measurements. We present UniDex-ViTac, a framework that uses human-video-guided simulation to generate robot demonstrations paired with fingertip contact observations for training a deployable visuo-tactile policy. Object-specific residual reinforcement learning specialists adapt annotated human-object interaction references to a robotic arm-hand system. Their successful rollouts pair final robot action targets with robot-side fingertip contact observations. From 50 human demonstrations across ten objects, we collect 10,000 simulated trajectories to train a single Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) based generalist. The policy combines point clouds, proprioception, and four binary contact signals encoded through fingertip labels and a separate token, without requiring human references or privileged object identity and pose at deployment. The contact-augmented configuration achieves 68.3% macro-average success in simulation, compared with 55.5% for the point-cloud-only baseline. Without real-robot demonstrations or policy fine-tuning, it succeeds in 73/110 physical trials (66.4%) across six seen and five unseen objects, compared with 60/110 (54.5%) for the baseline, an increase of 11.8 percentage points. These results support the feasibility of learning a unified visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policy from video-guided simulated interactions. Project page: https://unidex-vitac.github.io/
summary_zh: 人类视频展示灵巧操作，但缺乏机器人可执行的动作和触觉测量。我们提出 UniDex-ViTac，一个利用人类视频引导的仿真生成机器人演示，并与指尖接触观察配对，用于训练可部署的视觉-触觉策略的框架。针对特定物体的残差强化学习专家将标注过的人-物交互参考适配到机器人臂手系统上。其成功轨迹将最终机器人动作目标与机器人侧指尖接触观察配对。基于十个物体的五十个人类演示，我们收集了 10,000 条仿真轨迹，训练了一个基于 Transformer 的动作分块（ACT）通用策略。该策略结合点云、本体感觉和通过指尖标签及独立token编码的四路二值接触信号，部署时无需人类参考或物体身份与姿态的先验信息。在仿真中，接触增强配置实现了 68.3% 的宏平均成功率和 55.5% 的点云基线成功率形成对比。无需真实机器人演示或策略微调，在六个已知物体和五个未知物体的 73/110 次物理实验中成功（66.4%），相比基线 60/110（54.5%）提升了 11.8 个百分点。这些结果支持了从视频引导的仿真交互中学习统一视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略的可行性。项目页面：https://unidex-vitac.github.io/
tldr: UniDex-ViTac learns a unified visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policy from human videos by using simulation to generate robot demonstrations with contact observations, enabling successful deployment on real robots for both seen and unseen objects.
tldr_zh: UniDex-ViTac 利用人类视频引导的仿真生成带接触观测的机器人演示，训练统一的视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略，并成功部署到真实机器人上处理已知和未知物体。

title: Dense to MoE Adaptation for Compact Vision Language Action Policies
summary: Vision language action (VLA) policies continue to grow in parameter count, making deployment on resource-constrained robot platforms difficult. The central goal is to reduce the number of LLM-side parameters retained in the deployed policy while preserving downstream task performance. Our approach, AdaDE, adapts selected dense feed forward blocks into mixture of experts (MoE) layers and derives expert retention masks from router statistics during fine tuning. The Dense2MoE conversion preserves the original dense FFN function at initialization, so expert deactivation can start without a separate recovery stage. Instead of using a fixed shutdown rule, expert masks are updated dynamically from router usage statistics, with staged training and expert protection to avoid early collapse. With 40% of the LLM parameters deactivated, AdaDE retains 95.1% average success in LIBERO and 42.0% average success across all 50 RobotWin2.0 tasks. These results suggest that dense to MoE adaptation with dynamic expert deactivation is a practical direction for reducing active VLA model size without severe performance loss.
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的参数量持续增长，这使得其在资源受限的机器人平台上的部署变得困难。核心目标是在保持下游任务性能的同时，减少部署策略中所保留的大语言模型（LLM）侧参数量。我们提出的方法AdaDE将选定的密集前馈块适配为混合专家（MoE）层，并在微调过程中根据路由器统计信息推导专家保留掩码。Dense2MoE转换在初始化时保留了原始密集前馈网络（FFN）的功能，因此专家停用无需单独的重建阶段即可启动。专家掩码并非采用固定的停用规则，而是根据路由器使用统计信息动态更新，并辅以分阶段训练和专家保护机制，以避免早期崩溃。在停用40%的LLM参数的情况下，AdaDE在LIBERO基准上保留了95.1%的平均成功率，并在RobotWin2.0的全部50个任务中实现了42.0%的平均成功率。这些结果表明，基于动态专家停用的密集到MoE适配方法，是在不严重损失性能的前提下减小活跃VLA模型规模的一条切实可行的路径。
tldr: AdaDE adapts dense Vision-Language-Action policy models into mixture-of-experts layers with dynamically derived expert retention masks, retaining performance while deactivating 40% of LLM-side parameters.
tldr_zh: AdaDE 将稠密的视觉-语言-动作策略模型转换为混合专家层，并通过动态专家保留掩码，在停用 40% 的 LLM 侧参数的同时保持任务性能。

title: The Neverwhere Visual Parkour Benchmark Suite
summary: State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation by making it easier to create and integrate Gaussian splats-based reconstructions into simulated continuous testing setups. We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing policy checkpoints trained over multiple Neverwhere scenes and their performance when evaluated in novel scenes. Our analysis illustrates the necessity of sourcing diverse data to ensure performance. Code and data are available on the project page: https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/.
summary_zh: 最先进的视觉运动控制器日益能够处理复杂的视觉环境，这使得在部署之前评估其实际性能变得愈加困难。本研究旨在通过构建一套超逼真的闭环评估环境——即“Neverwhere基准套件”——来缩小这一训练与评估之间的差距。该套件包含六十多个基于三维高斯溅射重建的城市室内外场景。我们的目标是通过简化基于高斯溅射重建的创建与集成流程，使其能够更便捷地嵌入模拟连续测试环境中，从而推动大规模、可复现的机器人评估。同时，我们也强调仅依赖三维高斯生成数据进行训练可能存在的潜在风险，为此提供了在多个Neverwhere场景上训练得到的策略检查点，并展示这些策略在新场景中的评估表现。我们的分析表明，为确保性能，必须获取多样化的数据。代码和数据可在项目页面获取：https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/。
tldr: The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite provides over sixty photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting environments for closed-loop evaluation of visual locomotion controllers, along with trained policy checkpoints to analyze performance and data diversity requirements.
tldr_zh: Neverwhere基准套件提供了六十多个逼真的3D高斯溅射环境，用于视觉运动控制器的闭环评估，并附带训练好的策略检查点以分析性能和多样性的需求。

title: XRoboToolKit-T: Teleoperation with High Stability and Precision with Tactile Sensing for Contact-rich Manipulation
summary: Collecting high-quality robot data for contact-rich manipulation tasks is essential for enabling robots to acquire real-world skills. However, existing data collection solutions often lack the capability to obtain stable and high-frequency tactile feedback, limiting their effectiveness in contact-rich manipulation scenarios. In this work, we propose a versatile teleoperation system with tactile-driven assistance to enable high-frequency and stable contact-rich manipulation. The proposed XRoboToolKit-T teleoperation system incorporates a tactile-informed force control architecture, designed to ensure both stable and precise force control in contact-rich manipulation during teleoperation. The stabilizer haptic module rapidly analyzes the normal force distribution and infers pseudo shear force, enabling real-time tactile-based assistance during manipulation. The refiner haptic module integrates a vision-language-action model to predict and refine manipulation actions based on tactile sensing data and task descriptions. We apply the proposed teleoperation system to challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks, including grasping a deformable rubber pipette for liquid transfer and inserting a medical syringe into a vascular training pad, to demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-informed force control. Furthermore, the system achieves higher data collection efficiency and improved manipulation stability compared to state-of-the-art teleoperation without tactile assistance.
summary_zh: 收集接触丰富的操作任务中的高质量机器人数据，对于使机器人掌握真实世界技能至关重要。然而，现有的数据采集方案往往缺乏获取稳定且高频触觉反馈的能力，这限制了它们在接触丰富操作场景中的有效性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种具有触觉驱动辅助的多功能遥操作系统的XRoboToolKit-T，以实现高频且稳定的接触丰富操作。该系统采用了一种触觉感知的力控制架构，旨在确保遥操作过程中接触丰富操作中的稳定且精确的力控制。稳定器触觉模块能够快速分析法向力分布并推断伪剪切力，从而在操作过程中实现基于触觉的实时辅助。精调器触觉模块集成了视觉-语言-动作模型，能够基于触觉传感数据和任务描述预测并优化操作动作。我们将所提出的遥操作系统应用于具有挑战性的接触丰富操作任务中，包括抓取可变形橡胶移液管进行液体转移以及将医用注射器插入血管训练垫，以验证触觉感知力控制的有效性。此外，与现有未配备触觉辅助的先进遥操作技术相比，该系统在数据采集效率和操作稳定性方面均表现出更高的性能。
tldr: This paper presents XRoboToolKit-T, a teleoperation system that integrates tactile sensing and a vision-language-action model for stable, precise, and high-frequency force control in contact-rich manipulation tasks such as grasping deformable objects and medical syringe insertion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了XRoboToolKit-T，一种集成了触觉感知和视觉-语言-动作模型的遥操作系统，用于在接触丰富的操作任务中实现稳定、精确和高频率的力控制，如抓取可变形物体和医疗注射器插入。

title: Collision-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body Control under Imperfect Tracking Targets
summary: Humanoid robots often execute motion commands through whole-body controllers (WBCs) that track targets while maintaining balance and stability. However, most WBCs are blind to scene geometry, which can lead to collisions from imperfect target motions that are geometrically unsafe due to perception, planning, or teleoperation errors. We propose RECAL, a Robot--Environment Cross-Attention Layer that wraps a blind WBC to trade off target tracking against collision avoidance using external scene geometry. RECAL supports collision-aware tracking of floating-base and end-effector commands, including collision avoidance for held objects. It represents the robot, held objects, and environment as point clouds, using cross-attention between robot/object points and the environment to produce geometry-aware control features. In simulation, RECAL improves collision avoidance while preserving target-tracking performance across frozen-arm and adaptive-arm locomotion, object-carrying, and standing-manipulation scenarios relative to alternative geometry-aware WBC architectures. We further demonstrate the controller on a real Digit V3 humanoid robot.
summary_zh: 人形机器人通常通过全身控制器执行运动指令，在跟踪目标的同时维持平衡与稳定性。然而，大多数全身控制器对环境几何结构不具备感知能力，导致由于感知、规划或遥操作误差而产生的不完美目标运动可能在几何上不安全，从而引发碰撞。我们提出了RECAL，一种机器人-环境交叉注意力层，通过引入外部场景几何信息，对不具感知能力的全身控制器进行增强，以在目标跟踪与碰撞规避之间进行权衡。RECAL支持对浮动基座和末端执行器指令进行碰撞感知跟踪，并包括对携带物体的碰撞规避。它将机器人、携带物体及环境表示为点云，利用机器人/物体点与环境之间的交叉注意力生成几何感知控制特征。在仿真中，与替代的几何感知全身控制器架构相比，RECAL在冻结手臂和自适应手臂运动、物体搬运及站立操作等场景中，在保持目标跟踪性能的同时显著提升了碰撞规避能力。我们还在真实的Digit V3人形机器人上对该控制器进行了验证。
tldr: RECAL proposes a cross-attention layer that wraps a blind whole-body controller, using point clouds of the robot, held objects, and environment to enable collision-aware tracking of locomotion and manipulation commands on humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: RECAL 提出了一种交叉注意力层，通过点云表示机器人、携带物体和环境，使得全身控制器能够在跟踪运动指令时避免碰撞，并在仿真和实体 Digit V3 人形机器人上得到验证。

title: ManiSkillFormer: Demonstration-Free Compositional Manipulation via Task-Conditioned Geometric Contracts
summary: We present ManiSkillFormer, a neuro-symbolic framework for demonstration-free and compositional robotic manipulation. Instead of learning end-to-end visuomotor policies, ManiSkillFormer introduces task-conditioned geometric contracts that explicitly structure the interface between perception and action. Each manipulation skill declares the semantic geometric primitives required for execution, such as object keypoints and surface normals. Building on human-defined skill structures, LLM agents generate these contracts and corresponding motion templates for different objects and task contexts. These contracts guide the perception module to ground task-relevant 3D primitives from observations, which are then used to instantiate reusable motion templates stored in a skill library. We evaluate ManiSkillFormer on Galaxea R1-Lite dual-arm robot across three settings: zero-shot pick-and-place over 8 object categories with 30 different instances, functional manipulation tasks including unscrewing, pouring, pressing, and folding, and 3 long-horizon tasks. ManiSkillFormer achieves higher average success rates than the evaluated baselines and two ablated pipelines: 88.24% for demonstration-free pick-and-place, 75.00% average success on functional manipulation and 50--80% completion rates across the long-horizon tasks. These results show that our design enables composable and reusable manipulation across objects and tasks without per-object policy fine-tuning or additional robot demonstrations.
summary_zh: 我们提出了ManiSkillFormer，一种用于免示教、组合式机器人操作任务的神经符号框架。与端到端学习视觉-运动策略不同，ManiSkillFormer引入了任务条件化的几何契约，在感知与动作之间明确地构建了接口结构。每个操作技能声明执行所需的语义几何基元，如物体关键点和表面法线。基于人类定义的技能结构，大语言模型智能体为不同物体和任务场景生成这些契约及相应的运动模板。这些契约引导感知模块从观测中识别与任务相关的3D基元，进而用于实例化技能库中存储的可复用运动模板。我们在Galaxea R1-Lite双臂机器人上对ManiSkillFormer进行了评估，涵盖三种设定：8个物体类别、30个不同实例的零样本抓取-放置任务，包括拧松、倾倒、按压和折叠在内的功能性操作任务，以及3个长时程任务。ManiSkillFormer在平均成功率上均高于所对比的基线和两个消融流水线：零样本抓取-放置任务达到88.24%，功能性操作任务平均成功率为75.00%，长时程任务的完成率在50%至80%之间。这些结果表明，我们的设计能够在无需对每个物体进行策略微调或额外机器人示教的情况下，实现跨物体和跨任务的组合式、可复用操作。
tldr: ManiSkillFormer introduces task-conditioned geometric contracts generated by LLMs to enable demonstration-free, compositional robotic manipulation, achieving high success rates on real dual-arm robot tasks.
tldr_zh: ManiSkillFormer 通过由LLM生成的任务条件几何契约，实现了无需示范的组合式机器人操作，在真实双臂机器人任务上取得了高成功率。

title: Occupancy Network-Guided Autonomous Robotic Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Autonomous soft-tissue cancer surgery has been limited to interventions on organ surfaces, because current systems cannot perceive and adapt to anatomy once it deforms or is cut. We introduce the first vision-guided autonomous system capable of performing complete tumor resections for partial nephrectomy. Our system integrates conditional occupancy networks, trained entirely in a physics-based simulation, that infer full 3-D anatomy (tumor, margin tissue, and kidney) from single-view partial point clouds. These occupancy networks maintain intraoperative tracking even as tissue is cut and deformed, enabling adaptive planning and execution. The surgical platform combines a depth camera for capturing surface point clouds, dual robotic arms for electrosurgical cutting and vacuum-based tissue manipulation, and an autonomous control strategy for tumor resection. In patient-derived hydrogel phantoms under an open partial nephrectomy setting, the robot performed eight consecutive autonomous tumor resections comprising 77 electrosurgical cuts, with all cuts achieving negative surgical margins and 1.61 $\pm$ 0.48 mm mean absolute margin error. This work demonstrates, for the first time, a foundation for supervised autonomous closed-loop, imaging-driven, margin-negative tumor removal in phantoms.
summary_zh: 自主软组织癌症手术此前仅限于器官表面的介入治疗，因为现有系统在解剖结构发生变形或被切割后，无法感知并适应其变化。我们首次引入了一种视觉引导的自主系统，能够完成肾部分切除术中的完整肿瘤切除。我们的系统集成了条件占据网络，该网络完全在基于物理的仿真中训练，能够从单视角的部分点云中推断出完整的三维解剖结构（肿瘤、边缘组织和肾脏）。即使在组织被切割和变形的情况下，这些占据网络仍能保持术中跟踪，从而实现自适应规划与执行。该手术平台结合了用于采集表面点云的深度相机、用于电外科切割和基于真空的组织操控的双机械臂，以及用于肿瘤切除的自主控制策略。在开放式肾部分切除术设置下的患者来源水凝胶体模中，机器人连续完成了八次自主肿瘤切除，共涉及77次电外科切割，所有切割均实现阴性手术切缘，平均绝对切缘误差为1.61 $\pm$ 0.48 mm。本研究首次展示了在体模中实现受监督的自主闭环、影像驱动、阴性切缘肿瘤切除的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces the first vision-guided autonomous robotic system for complete tumor resections in partial nephrectomy, integrating occupancy networks for intraoperative 3D anatomy tracking from partial point clouds and enabling adaptive planning and execution. The system demonstrates negative surgical margins across eight consecutive tumor resections in patient-derived phantoms.
tldr_zh: 本论文介绍了首个视觉引导的自主机器人系统，用于部分肾切除术中的完全肿瘤切除，集成占用网络以从部分点云推断术中3D解剖结构，并实现自适应规划与执行。该系统在患者来源的体模中连续八次切除肿瘤均达到阴性切缘。

title: ENCP: Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Uncertainty estimation for Vision-Language-Navigation (VLN) models is a critical task since it can help identify ambiguous and unreliable predictions, enabling agents to make safer navigation decisions. As one of the most advanced uncertainty estimation frameworks, conformal prediction (CP) offers a promising approach for uncertainty estimation in VLN. However, given that VLN agent requires a sequence of steps, standard calibration in conformal prediction fails to provide coverage guarantee it promises over a dependent, variable-length VLN episode. To this end, we propose Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction (ENCP), which rescales a nonconformity score by the policy's residual confidence and calibrates one maximum score per episode. Under exchangeable calibration and test episodes, this construction covers the ground truth at every step with probability at least $1 - α$, while allowing dependence among steps within an episode. Across four VLN policies and three nonconformity scores on R2R and REVERIE dataset, ENCP meets all reported empirical step-coverage targets on the seen-to-unseen evaluation. These results demonstrate that ENCP can provide model-agnostic uncertainty estimates, which might be useful for determining when a VLN agent should defer to a more capable predictor, including human assistance.
summary_zh: 摘要：视觉-语言-导航（VLN）模型的不确定性估计是一项关键任务，因为它有助于识别模糊和不可靠的预测，从而使智能体能够做出更安全的导航决策。作为最先进的不确定性估计框架之一，共形预测（CP）为VLN中的不确定性估计提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，由于VLN智能体需要一系列步骤，共形预测中的标准校准无法在依赖性强且长度可变的VLN轨迹上提供其所承诺的覆盖保证。为此，我们提出了情节归一化共形预测（ENCP），该方法通过策略的残差置信度对非符合性分数进行重新缩放，并在每个情节中校准一个最大分数。在可交换的校准和测试情节条件下，该构造能以至少$1 - α$的概率在每个步骤覆盖真实值，同时允许情节内各步骤之间的依赖性。在R2R和REVERIE数据集上，针对四种VLN策略和三种非符合性分数，ENCP在从已知到未知的评估中均达到了所有报告的经验步骤覆盖率目标。这些结果表明，ENCP能够提供与模型无关的不确定性估计，这可能有助于确定VLN智能体何时应转而依赖更强大的预测器（包括人工辅助）。
tldr: ENCP introduces an episode-normalized conformal prediction method to provide per-step coverage guarantees for vision-and-language navigation agents, calibrating one maximum nonconformity score per episode to handle dependent, variable-length trajectories.
tldr_zh: ENCP 提出了一种基于情节归一化的保形预测方法，通过为每个情节校准一个最大不一致分数，为视觉语言导航代理提供逐步覆盖保证，以处理依赖性和可变长度的轨迹。

title: Dissecting Motion-Prior Regularization for Data-Scarce Robotic Insertion
summary: This study asks whether training-time motion-prior regularization can improve insertion success when a diffusion policy is learned from only 15 demonstrations. Minimum jerk discourages abrupt changes in predicted translational acceleration; speed-curvature regularization instead couples movement speed to path geometry. These are candidate mechanisms for task completion, not safety guarantees. We compare the priors individually and jointly, neither prior, and generic smoothness, with 80 real-robot trials per setting pooled over four recorded condition classes. Joint and minimum-jerk-only settings each achieved 70/80 successes (87.5%), versus 69/80 (86.3%) for speed-curvature only, 66/80 (82.5%) for neither prior, and 67/80 (83.8%) for generic smoothness. Success rates and Wilson 95% confidence intervals are visualized for direct comparison. Joint regularization exceeded neither by 5.0 percentage points but provided no observed gain over minimum jerk alone. The results motivate minimum jerk as the simpler candidate for replication, without establishing synergy, biomechanical specificity, improved safety, or distribution-shift robustness.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在仅基于15次演示学习扩散策略时，训练阶段引入运动先验正则化是否能够提升插入操作的成功率。最小加加速度正则化用于抑制预测平移加速度中的突变；而速度-曲率正则化则将运动速度与路径几何特征相耦合。这两种机制旨在促进任务完成，而非提供安全保障。我们在四种记录条件下分别对两种先验单独、联合使用，以及不使用任何先验和采用通用平滑性正则化的情况进行了对比，每种设置进行了80次真实机器人试验。联合正则化与仅使用最小加加速度的设置均实现了70/80次成功（87.5%），仅使用速度-曲率正则化为69/80次（86.3%），不使用先验为66/80次（82.5%），通用平滑性为67/80次（83.8%）。我们可视化了成功率及Wilson 95%置信区间以供直接比较。联合正则化相比无先验设置提升了5.0个百分点，但与仅使用最小加加速度相比未观察到额外增益。结果表明，最小加加速度是更简单的可复制候选方案，但并未证实协同效应、生物力学特异性、安全性提升或分布偏移鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper investigates whether motion-prior regularization, such as minimum jerk and speed-curvature, improves diffusion policy insertion success with limited demonstrations, finding that minimum jerk is the simpler effective prior.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了运动先验正则化（如最小加加速度和速度-曲率）是否能在少量演示下提高扩散策略的插入成功率，发现最小加加速度是更简单有效的先验。

title: Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Hybrid Systems: Unified Goal-Driven Control with Safety Guarantees
summary:
Hybrid dynamical systems provide a powerful modeling framework for robotic systems, particularly in contact-rich environments. However, ensuring safety and performance in such systems remains challenging due to the intricate coupling between continuous dynamics and discrete mode transitions. In this work, we extend classical Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis, a formal verification method for continuous-time nonlinear systems, to hybrid dynamical systems. Our framework characterizes safe sets for hybrid systems through a generalized value function defined over both discrete and continuous states while accounting for control constraints and model uncertainty. We additionally provide a numerical algorithm to compute this value function.
  Building on these safe sets, we propose two different mechanisms to integrate performance objectives. First, we introduce a hybrid least-restrictive safety filter that intervenes on both the discrete and continuous components of a nominal controller only when necessary to avoid unsafe states, thereby preserving nominal behavior whenever possible. Second, we formulate and compute hybrid backward reach-avoid tubes, enabling the simultaneous enforcement of safety and goal-reaching behavior, an extension not previously addressed within hybrid HJ reachability. This enables the synthesis of continuous and discrete control policies that guarantee both safety and task completion. We validate our framework through simulation studies and real-world experiments on a quadrupedal robot, demonstrating its effectiveness in hybrid mode planning and safety-critical applications.
summary_zh:
混合动力系统为机器人系统，尤其是在富含接触的环境中，提供了强大的建模框架。然而，由于连续动力学与离散模式转换之间错综复杂的耦合，确保此类系统的安全性与性能仍然是一项挑战。在本工作中，我们将经典的Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析——一种针对连续时间非线性系统的形式化验证方法——扩展至混合动力系统。我们的框架通过定义在离散和连续状态上的广义值函数，同时考虑控制约束与模型不确定性，来刻画混合系统的安全集合。此外，我们提供了一种数值算法来计算该值函数。

基于这些安全集合，我们提出了两种整合性能目标的机制。首先，我们引入了一种混合最小限制性安全滤波器，该滤波器仅在必要时对名义控制器的离散和连续分量进行干预，以避免进入不安全状态，从而在可能的情况下尽量保持名义行为不变。其次，我们构建并计算了混合后向可达-避碰管道，从而能够同时强制执行安全性与目标到达行为，这是此前在混合HJ可达性研究中未曾涉及的扩展。这使得我们能够综合出既保证安全性又确保任务完成的连续与离散控制策略。我们通过仿真研究以及在四足机器人上的真实世界实验验证了所提出的框架，展示了其在混合模式规划与安全关键应用中的有效性。
tldr: This paper extends Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis to hybrid dynamical systems, providing a unified framework for safety and goal-reaching control with formal guarantees, validated on a quadrupedal robot.
tldr_zh: 本文将Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析扩展到混合动力系统，为安全与目标到达控制提供了统一框架，并在四足机器人上进行了验证。

title: SlotDiT: Object-Centric Representations for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Text-conditioned latent diffusion models perform strongly in video generation and are promising backbones for robotic applications. However, existing approaches rely on pixel-level or VAE-based latent representations that lack explicit semantic structure, leaving the impact of the representation space largely unexplored. Slot-based object-centric representations offer a structured alternative by decomposing scenes into object-level latents, or slots. While they have shown success in dynamics modeling and planning, they have not yet been explored for diffusion-based generative modeling. We introduce SlotDiT, a text-guided Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates in a slot-based latent space. Given a reference image and a language instruction, SlotDiT decomposes the scene into object-centric slots representing individual entities. Conditioned on the instruction and observed scene context, the model autoregressively denoises future slot trajectories to predict scene dynamics. To systematically investigate latent-space design for diffusion transformers, we compare slot-based representations against VAE-based and semantics-aligned alternatives within a unified DiT framework. Our experiments show that using slots as DiT latents yields competitive video generation quality while consistently improving task-completion rates across four robotic datasets. Furthermore, their compact representation provides a computationally efficient alternative to VAE-based and semantics-aligned latent spaces. Overall, our results demonstrate that object-centric structure is a powerful inductive bias for diffusion-based generative modeling in robotic environments. The project page is available at https://slot-dit.github.io/.
summary_zh: 文本条件潜在扩散模型在视频生成方面表现出色，并有望成为机器人应用的基础架构。然而，现有方法依赖像素级或基于VAE的潜在表示，这些表示缺乏显式的语义结构，导致表示空间的影响在很大程度上尚未被探索。基于槽位的对象中心表示通过将场景分解为对象级潜在变量（即槽位），提供了一种结构化的替代方案。尽管这类表示在动力学建模和规划中已显示出成功，但尚未被用于基于扩散的生成建模。我们提出了SlotDiT，一种在槽位潜在空间中运行的文本引导扩散Transformer（DiT）。给定参考图像和语言指令，SlotDiT将场景分解为表示各个实体的对象中心槽位。在指令和观测场景上下文的条件下，模型自回归地去噪未来的槽位轨迹，以预测场景动态。为了系统性地研究扩散Transformer的潜在空间设计，我们在统一的DiT框架中，将槽位表示与基于VAE和语义对齐的替代方案进行了比较。实验表明，将槽位作为DiT潜在变量能够产生具有竞争力的视频生成质量，同时在四个机器人数据集中持续提升任务完成率。此外，其紧凑的表示形式为基于VAE和语义对齐的潜在空间提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。总体而言，我们的结果表明，对象中心结构是机器人环境中基于扩散的生成建模的一种强大归纳偏置。项目页面可在https://slot-dit.github.io/获取。
tldr: SlotDiT introduces a text-guided Diffusion Transformer that operates on slot-based object-centric representations, achieving competitive video generation quality while improving task completion across robotic datasets.
tldr_zh: SlotDiT 提出了一种在基于槽的对象中心表示上运行的文本引导扩散变换器，在实现竞争性视频生成质量的同时，提高了机器人数据集上的任务完成率。

title: Optimized Wrench Polytope Analysis for Real-Time Stability Control of Legged Robots in Complex Multi-Contact Configurations
summary: Legged robots offer a variety of automation applications in real-world scenarios. But areas that are difficult to traverse, like slopes, caves, or scaffolding, still pose a great challenge for traversal. To tackle this problem, we propose an optimized algorithm for evaluating the full actuatable wrench polytope for arbitrary contact scenarios. With our improved analysis algorithm, the torques for each joint of the robot can be calculated within a control frequency of 49 Hz. The achieved speedup allows for deployment within a regular control loop for actuating robot poses for different contact scenarios. We evaluated our stability controller extensively in simulation scenarios and validated its applicability by deploying it on actual walking robot hardware. The proposed controller achieved stability in very complex scenarios that are currently not achievable by any other controller.
summary_zh: 腿式机器人在现实场景中具有多种自动化应用潜力。然而，诸如斜坡、洞穴或脚手架等难以通行的区域，仍对其跨越能力构成重大挑战。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种优化算法，用于评估任意接触场景下的完整可执行力多面体。通过改进后的分析算法，可在49 Hz的控制频率内计算机器人各关节的力矩。所实现的加速性能使该算法能够部署于常规控制回路中，以针对不同接触场景驱动机器人姿态。我们在仿真场景中广泛评估了所提出的稳定性控制器，并通过在实际行走机器人硬件上的部署验证了其适用性。该控制器在极为复杂的场景中实现了稳定性，而这些场景目前是其他任何控制器均无法实现的。
tldr: This paper presents an optimized wrench polytope analysis algorithm that enables real-time stability control for legged robots in complex multi-contact scenarios, achieving 49 Hz joint torque computation and validated on real hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种优化的力多边形分析方法，可在复杂多接触场景中实现足式机器人的实时稳定性控制，关节力矩计算频率达到49Hz，并在真实硬件上验证。

title: Calibrate Once, Fly Any Team: Residual-Grounded Low-Fidelity Training for Cooperative Drone Swarms
summary:
Training multi-agent drone-swarm policies directly in high-fidelity (HF) rigid-body physics is accurate but computationally expensive. This cost scales poorly with team size, as each additional agent multiplies contact-resolution complexity and sharply raises the in-simulation crash rate. To address this, we propose a mixed-fidelity training scheme that eliminates HF reinforcement learning entirely.
  A single shared, decentralized policy is optimized inside a fully-differentiable, JAX-native low-fidelity (LF) point-mass simulator. The simulator is corrected by a small, per-agent bagged residual ensemble fit once, offline, using short calibration flights in the HF simulator. Because calibration requires only one isolated drone, the data collection budget does not compound with team size. Reference trajectories are generated by rolling out an existing LF-only policy and tracked in the HF simulator by a zero-training PD controller.
  Evaluated across four cooperative drone tasks and team sizes from 3 to 18, the residual-corrected policy outperforms an uncorrected LF baseline in all combinations, and a from-scratch HF policy in 22 of 24 combinations tested. It trails an HF-finetuned policy by a margin that narrows steadily with team size. Ultimately, the proposed method achieves near-equivalent performance at the largest team sizes at a fraction of the computational cost, completely avoiding the high crash rates typical of HF training.
summary_zh:
直接在高保真（HF）刚体物理环境中训练多智能体无人机集群策略虽然精确，但计算成本高昂。该成本随团队规模的扩大而急剧增长，因为每增加一个智能体，接触解析的复杂度便成倍增加，同时模拟中的碰撞率也显著上升。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种混合保真度训练方案，完全消除了对高保真强化学习的需求。

一个共享的、去中心化的策略在完全可微的、基于JAX原生的低保真（LF）质点模拟器中进行优化。该模拟器通过一个小型的、逐智能体袋装残差集成进行校正，该集成仅在离线状态下，利用高保真模拟器中的短时校准飞行数据拟合一次。由于校准仅需一架孤立无人机，数据采集预算不会随团队规模而增加。参考轨迹通过 rollout 现有的仅低保真策略生成，并由一个零训练的PD控制器在高保真模拟器中跟踪。

在四项协作无人机任务及3至18架不等的团队规模上评估后，残差校正策略在所有组合中均优于未校正的低保真基线策略，并在测试的24种组合中，有22种优于从零开始训练的高保真策略。与高保真微调策略相比，其性能差距随团队规模增大而稳步缩小。最终，所提方法在最大团队规模下以极低的计算成本实现了近乎等效的性能，并完全避免了高保真训练中典型的高碰撞率问题。
tldr: This paper proposes a mixed-fidelity training scheme for cooperative drone swarms, using a residual-grounded low-fidelity simulator to train a decentralized policy that nearly matches high-fidelity performance at a fraction of the computational cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于合作无人机集群的混合保真度训练方案，利用残差校正的低保真度模拟器训练分散策略，以极低的计算成本实现接近高保真度的性能。

title: CAD-Based Relation Learning and Geometric-Symbolic Planning for Robotic Assembly
summary: Assembly Sequence Planning (ASP) remains a challenging problem due to its combinatorial nature, making exhaustive planning approaches impractical for complex industrial assemblies. Furthermore, many CAD models lack reliable semantic contact information or require extensive manual preprocessing, limiting the applicability of existing methods. This paper presents a hybrid ASP framework combining learning-based relation extraction with geometric-symbolic reasoning to generate feasible robotic disassembly sequences from imperfect CAD data. A neural network predicts semantic geometric relations from point clouds, while human-in-the-loop verification enables correction of uncertain predictions and planning failures. Extracted relations are transformed into a symbolic assembly graph, enabling a geometric-symbolic planner to efficiently compute locally valid sets of robotic manipulation primitives. A visibility-based ray-casting strategy guides the search for feasible disassembly directions without requiring an exhaustive combinatorial search, while the local solution space enables efficient sequence optimization. The framework is evaluated on an introduced assembly dataset and on the ASAP test dataset. On the ASAP test dataset, the proposed planner achieves an 85.83% planning success rate while reducing the median planning time by more than one order of magnitude across all assembly sizes and by more than a factor of 50 for assemblies with more than 30 components compared to the baseline. The results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid framework enables efficient robotic assembly sequence planning from imperfect CAD data while substantially reducing planning time. By combining learning-based feature segmentation, human-in-the-loop verification, and geometric-symbolic reasoning, the framework provides a practical foundation for scalable and adaptable robotic assembly and disassembly planning.
summary_zh: 装配序列规划（ASP）因其组合爆炸特性而始终是一个具有挑战性的问题，这使得穷举式规划方法难以适用于复杂的工业装配体。此外，许多CAD模型缺乏可靠的语义接触信息，或需要大量的人工预处理，从而限制了现有方法的适用性。本文提出了一种混合ASP框架，将基于学习的关系提取与几何-符号推理相结合，以从不完美的CAD数据中生成可行的机器人拆卸序列。神经网络从点云中预测语义几何关系，同时人在回路验证机制能够对不确定预测和规划失败进行修正。提取出的关系被转换为符号装配图，使几何-符号规划器能够高效地计算局部有效的机器人操作原语集合。基于可见性的射线投射策略引导可行拆卸方向的搜索，无需进行穷举组合搜索，而局部解空间则支持高效的序列优化。该框架在一个引入的装配数据集和ASAP测试数据集上进行了评估。在ASAP测试数据集上，所提出的规划器实现了85.83%的规划成功率，同时将中位规划时间在所有装配规模下减少了一个数量级以上，对于包含30个以上组件的装配体，相较于基线方法减少了超过50倍。结果表明，所提出的混合框架能够从不完美的CAD数据中实现高效的机器人装配序列规划，同时大幅缩短规划时间。通过将基于学习的特征分割、人在回路验证和几何-符号推理相结合，该框架为可扩展且适应性强的机器人装配与拆卸规划提供了实用基础。
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid Assembly Sequence Planning framework combining neural relation extraction from point clouds, human-in-the-loop verification, and geometric-symbolic planning to efficiently generate feasible robotic disassembly sequences from imperfect CAD data, achieving high success rates and order-of-magnitude speedups.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合装配序列规划框架，结合点云神经关系提取、人在回路验证和几何符号规划，从有缺陷的CAD数据中高效生成可行的机器人拆卸序列，在保持高成功率的同时大幅缩短规划时间。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Koopman Operator Synthesis for Mechanical Systems
summary: Finite-dimensional Koopman models enable efficient linear prediction and control of nonlinear robotic systems. However, models learned purely from trajectory data may violate the energetic structure of the underlying mechanics, producing predictions that exhibit artificial energy growth and diverge under recursive propagation. This work presents a structure-preserving Koopman framework for Euler-Lagrange systems built on generalized-momentum coordinates. The momentum transformation exposes the mechanical actuation as a known, state-independent port, which is preserved explicitly in the lifted dynamics. A structure-constrained neural architecture is developed to jointly learn the lifting functions and a port-Hamiltonian Koopman generator, rendering the learned dynamics passive by construction rather than through penalty terms or post-hoc projection. A Cayley-midpoint discretization further preserves the corresponding storage-dissipation balance exactly in discrete time. These properties are established analytically by deriving the discrete storage balance and associated stability guarantees of the learned predictor. Simulation and experimental studies demonstrate improved prediction accuracy, data efficiency, and closed-loop tracking over Koopman baselines, with increasing gains for higher-dimensional systems.
summary_zh: 有限维Koopman模型能够实现对非线性机器人系统的高效线性预测与控制。然而，仅从轨迹数据中学习的模型可能违背底层力学系统的能量结构，导致预测结果出现人为能量增长，并在递归传播中发散。本研究提出了一种基于广义动量坐标、面向欧拉-拉格朗日系统的保结构Koopman框架。动量变换将机械驱动暴露为已知的、与状态无关的端口，并在升维动力学中显式保留。本文开发了一种结构约束的神经架构，用于联合学习升维函数和端口-哈密顿Koopman生成器，使学习到的动力学通过构造而非惩罚项或事后投影即具备无源性。Cayley中点离散化进一步在离散时间中精确保持相应的存储-耗散平衡。通过推导离散存储平衡及所学预测器的相关稳定性保证，本文从理论上确立了这些性质。仿真与实验研究表明，相较于Koopman基线方法，所提方法在预测精度、数据效率和闭环跟踪方面均有提升，且对高维系统的改善效果更为显著。
tldr: This paper proposes a structure-preserving Koopman operator framework for Euler-Lagrange systems that learns a port-Hamiltonian Koopman generator for mechanical systems, ensuring passivity and accurate prediction for nonlinear robotic control.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于欧拉-拉格朗日系统的保结构Koopman算子框架，通过学习端口哈密顿Koopman生成器，确保机械系统的无源性和预测准确性，以用于非线性机器人控制。

title: Kernel-Based Metrics Learning for Uncertain Opponent Vehicle Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racing confronts significant challenges in safely overtaking Opponent Vehicles (OVs) that exhibit uncertain trajectories, stemming from unknown driving policies. To address these challenges, this study proposes heterogeneous kernel metrics for Deep Kernel Learning (DKL), designed to robustly capture the diverse driving policies of OVs, and carry out precise trajectory predictions along with the associated uncertainties. A key virtue of the proposed kernel metrics lies in their ability to align similar driving policies and disjoin dissimilar ones in an unsupervised manner, given the observed interactions between the Ego Vehicle (EV) and OVs. The efficacy of the proposed method is substantiated through experimental studies on a 1/10th scale racecar platform, demonstrating improved prediction accuracy and thereby safely overtaking against OVs. Furthermore, our method is computationally efficient for onboard computing units, affirming its viability in fast-paced racing environments. The video and source code can be found at https://github.com/HMCL-UNIST/OpponentPredictionWithKMDKL.git.
summary_zh: 自主赛车在安全超越具有不确定轨迹的对手车辆时面临重大挑战，这些不确定性源于其未知的驾驶策略。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了用于深度核学习的异构核度量，旨在稳健地捕捉对手车辆的多样化驾驶策略，并实现精确的轨迹预测及其相关不确定性。所提出的核度量的关键优势在于，在观察到自车与对手车辆之间的交互后，其能够以无监督方式对齐相似的驾驶策略并区分不相似的策略。通过在1/10比例赛车平台上的实验研究，验证了所提方法的有效性，结果表明其提高了预测精度，从而实现了对对手车辆的安全超越。此外，我们的方法在计算上对车载计算单元具有高效性，证实了其在高速竞赛环境中的可行性。视频和源代码可在 https://github.com/HMCL-UNIST/OpponentPredictionWithKMDKL.git 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces heterogeneous kernel metrics for Deep Kernel Learning to improve uncertain opponent vehicle trajectory prediction in autonomous racing, validated on a 1/10th scale racecar platform for safe overtaking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出用于深度核学习的异构核度量，以改进自动驾驶赛车中不确定对手车辆轨迹预测，并在1/10比例赛车平台上验证了安全超车能力。

title: Continual Learning for Traversability Prediction with Uncertainty-Aware Adaptation
summary: Traversability prediction is a critical component of autonomous navigation in unstructured environments, where complex and uncertain robot-terrain interactions pose significant challenges such as traction loss and dynamic instability. Despite recent progress in learning-based traversability prediction, these methods often fail to adapt to novel terrains. Even when adaptation is achieved, retaining experience from previously trained environments remains a challenge, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose a continual learning framework for traversability prediction that incrementally adapts to new terrains using a generative experience recall model. A key virtue of the proposed framework is two folds: i) retain prior experience without storing past data; and ii) incorporate the uncertainty of the generated samples from the recall model, enabling uncertainty-aware adaptation. Real-world experiments with a skid-steering robot validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, demonstrating its ability to adapt across a series of diverse environments while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
summary_zh: 可穿越性预测是无人系统在非结构化环境中自主导航的关键组成部分，在此类环境中，复杂且不确定的机器人-地形交互会引发牵引力丧失和动态失稳等重大挑战。尽管基于学习的可穿越性预测方法近年来取得了进展，但这些方法往往难以适应新颖地形。即便实现了适应，如何保留先前训练环境中的经验仍然是一个难题，这一问题被称为灾难性遗忘。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于可穿越性预测的持续学习框架，该框架通过生成式经验回放模型逐步适应新地形。该框架的核心优势体现在两个方面：其一，无需存储历史数据即可保留先前经验；其二，引入回放模型生成样本的不确定性，实现不确定性感知的自适应。采用滑移转向机器人的实际实验验证了所提框架的有效性，证明了其在一系列多样化环境中进行适应并缓解灾难性遗忘的能力。
tldr: The paper proposes a continual learning framework for traversability prediction in unstructured terrains, using a generative experience recall model for uncertainty-aware adaptation and mitigating catastrophic forgetting, validated on a skid-steering robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于非结构化地形可穿越性预测的持续学习框架，通过生成式经验回放模型实现不确定性感知的适应并缓解灾难性遗忘，并在滑移转向机器人上进行了验证。

title: Intrinsic Robot Rewarding: Reusing VLA Representations for Autonomous Evaluation and Policy Improvement
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) systems already bring together two valuable resources for robot learning: rich visual representations and demonstrations of successful task execution. Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR) proposes to use these resources for a second, complementary purpose: evaluating the robot's own outcomes and providing feedback for policy improvement. Successful demonstration endpoints define task-specific references, and the policy's frozen visual encoder provides the feature space in which new outcomes are assessed. The core reward mechanism adds a reference bank and a scoring operation to the existing pipeline, without requiring a separate learned evaluator or an additional perception backbone. Our position is that this reuse offers a promising route to lower integration effort, efficient reward computation, and reduced recurring human outcome scoring. Building on established research in visual rewards and learning from experience, IRR brings these ideas into the robot's existing perception and demonstration pipeline. An operational COMAU Racer 3 demonstrator is available at technology readiness level 4 (TRL 4). This laboratory foundation supports the next research step: connecting internal outcome evaluation to physical policy improvement. We present the reward formulation, central research questions, and an evaluation methodology linking reward reliability to task success and supervision effort. The intended contribution is a reusable approach to learn and improve from the data and experience already available in industrial robot systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统已将为机器人学习提供的两种宝贵资源结合在一起：丰富的视觉表征和成功任务执行的演示。内在机器人奖励（IRR）提出将这些资源用于第二个互补目的：评估机器人自身的结果，并为策略改进提供反馈。成功演示的终点定义了任务特定参考，而策略的冻结视觉编码器则提供了评估新结果的特征空间。核心奖励机制在现有流程中增加了参考库和评分操作，无需单独的学习评估器或额外的感知主干网络。我们的立场是，这种复用为实现更低的集成成本、高效的奖励计算以及减少重复的人工结果评分提供了一条有前景的路径。基于视觉奖励和从经验中学习的既有研究，IRR将这些理念引入机器人现有的感知和演示流程中。一个可运行的COMAU Racer 3演示系统已达到技术就绪水平4（TRL 4）。这一实验室基础支持下一步研究：将内部结果评估与物理策略改进相连接。我们提出了奖励公式、核心研究问题，以及一种将奖励可靠性与任务成功率和监督成本联系起来的评估方法。预期贡献是一种可复用的方法，能够利用工业机器人系统中已有的数据和经验进行学习与改进。
tldr: This paper introduces Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR), a framework that reuses VLA model representations and demonstration endpoints to provide autonomous reward evaluation for policy improvement without a separate learned evaluator, demonstrated on an industrial COMAU Racer 3 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了内在机器人奖励（IRR）框架，通过复用VLA模型表示和示范终点来实现自主奖励评估和政策改进，无需单独学习的评估器，并在COMAU Racer 3工业机器人上进行了演示。

title: Learning Options for Compositional Motor Control with Adapter Banks
summary: Learning flexible motor primitives is a hallmark of skilled motor control. Recent neuroscience theory proposes that motor primitives may be implemented as low-rank perturbations of a shared recurrent network, but leaves open how such a system is learned. We translate this principle into a novel architecture for learning motor skills end-to-end: a shared recurrent core modulated by a bank of residual adapters, each selected by a discrete latent code. Trained on closed-loop biomechanical control, the adapters develop emergent low-rank perturbations of the recurrent dynamics despite no architectural rank constraint, placing task representations in disparate subspaces of the shared core network. A simple high-level policy over the learned options, optimized while the whole network is frozen, sequences the low-rank adapters to produce novel out-of-distribution movements. We demonstrate the ability to generalize to novel motor sequences within the closed-loop control setting, improving on the generalization error of a task-input-conditioned multitask baseline by upto order of magnitude.
summary_zh: 学习灵活的运动基元是熟练运动控制的一个标志性特征。最近的神经科学理论提出，运动基元可能通过共享循环网络中的低秩扰动来实现，但该理论未阐明此类系统是如何学习的。我们将这一原理转化为一种用于端到端运动技能学习的新型架构：一个由一组残差适配器调制的共享循环核心，每个适配器通过离散潜变量代码进行选择。在闭环生物力学控制任务上训练后，适配器在没有任何架构秩约束的情况下，自发地产生对循环动力学的低秩扰动，将任务表征置于共享核心网络的不同子空间中。一个基于所学选项的简单高层策略（在整个网络冻结时进行优化）对这些低秩适配器进行排序，以生成新颖的分布外运动。我们展示了在闭环控制设置中泛化至新颖运动序列的能力，其泛化误差相较任务输入条件的多任务基线最多降低了一个数量级。
tldr: The paper proposes a motor control architecture with a shared recurrent core modulated by a bank of residual adapters selected by discrete latent codes, enabling compositional motor primitives and out-of-distribution generalization in closed-loop biomechanical control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种运动控制架构，通过离散潜码选择残差适配器来调制共享循环核心，实现组合运动原语，并在闭环生物力学控制中实现了分布外泛化。

title: Bridging Learned Visual Perception and Symbolic Belief-Space Planning
summary: In partially observable settings, agents must act without full knowledge of the world state and rely on uncertain state-estimation pipelines. Obtaining grounded and verifiable symbolic plans under such uncertainty remains a key challenge. Recent work has integrated Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to bridge perception and symbolic reasoning, following two main paradigms. The first, VLM-as-planner, maps images directly to action sequences, and the second, VLM-as-grounder, grounds observations into symbolic predicates used as the initial state by off-the-shelf planners. Both approaches ignore uncertainty in the planning process, compromising robustness. We introduce a third paradigm, VLM-as-probabilistic-grounder, a novel approach that captures the uncertainty of VLM predicate groundings as a probability distribution over symbolic states. This enables planning in belief space and producing robust plans under uncertainty. Experiments in simulated household robot settings show improved robustness and task success over deterministic grounding, underscoring how our approach leverages foundation models for reliable planning under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 在部分可观测的环境中，智能体必须在缺乏对世界状态完全了解的情况下行动，并依赖不确定的状态估计流程。在这种不确定性下获得有依据且可验证的符号规划仍然是一个关键挑战。近期的研究将视觉-语言模型（VLMs）融入感知与符号推理之间的桥梁，主要遵循两种范式。第一种范式为“VLM作为规划器”，直接将图像映射为动作序列；第二种范式为“VLM作为接地器”，将观测结果转化为符号谓词，作为现成规划器的初始状态。这两种方法均忽略了规划过程中的不确定性，从而削弱了鲁棒性。我们提出第三种范式——“VLM作为概率接地器”，这是一种新颖的方法，将VLM谓词接地的不确定性捕捉为符号状态上的概率分布。这使得在信念空间中进行规划成为可能，并在不确定性下生成鲁棒的计划。在模拟家庭机器人环境中的实验表明，与确定性接地相比，我们的方法在鲁棒性和任务成功率上均有显著提升，凸显了我们在不确定性条件下利用基础模型实现可靠规划的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a third paradigm, VLM-as-probabilistic-grounder, which captures the uncertainty of VLM predicate groundings as a probability distribution over symbolic states to enable robust belief-space planning in partially observable household robot settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了第三种范式，即VLM作为概率接地器，将VLM谓词接地的的不确定性捕获为符号状态上的概率分布，从而在部分可观察的家庭机器人环境中实现鲁棒的信念空间规划。

title: LEAP: Learning Emergent Active Perception for Quadruped Navigation
summary: Active perception allows autonomous agents to select their viewpoints rather than passively process the viewpoints given to them, enabling them to target where to reduce uncertainty about their environment. Learned systems typically encourage this behavior with hand-designed proxy objectives, such as coverage or curiosity bonuses, that may conflict with the task. In this work, we propose a method to learn emergent active perception (LEAP) without augmentation of the task objective. We formulate the problem of goal-oriented navigation over hazardous terrains with goals that must be discovered visually. We then propose an architecture for navigation policies with active perception, and train them on a terrain curriculum where task pressure alone leads to the emergence of gaze control. Key to this emergence, LEAP works on a gaze-invariant representation that integrates depth images into egocentric belief maps. We validate its performance in held-out evaluation scenarios, where it achieves a 92.7% success rate, compared to 74.2% for scripted or 34.5% for passive perception, and comes within 4.6 points of a privileged oracle. We validate that LEAP navigation policies, unchanged, can be directly applied to steering quadrupedal locomotion policies in physics simulation.
summary_zh: 主动感知使自主智能体能够选择其观察视角，而非被动地处理给定的视角信息，从而使其能够有针对性地减少对周围环境的不确定性。基于学习的方法通常通过手工设计的代理目标（如覆盖率或好奇心奖励）来鼓励该行为，但这些目标可能与任务目标相冲突。在本研究中，我们提出一种无需增强任务目标即可学习涌现式主动感知（LEAP）的方法。我们将危险地形上的目标导向导航问题形式化，其中目标必须通过视觉发现。随后，我们提出一种具备主动感知能力的导航策略架构，并在一个地形课程上对其进行训练，在该课程中，仅凭任务压力即可催生视线控制的涌现。LEAP方法的关键在于，它基于一种视线不变表示进行工作，该表示将深度图像整合到以自我为中心的信念地图中。我们在留出评估场景中验证了其性能，在该场景下，LEAP实现了92.7%的成功率，相比之下，脚本化感知为74.2%，被动感知为34.5%，且与特权级理想模型（privileged oracle）的差距仅在4.6个百分点以内。我们进一步验证，LEAP导航策略无需修改即可直接应用于物理仿真中四足机器人运动策略的引导。
tldr: LEAP introduces a method for quadruped navigation that learns emergent active perception from task pressure alone, using a gaze-invariant egocentric belief representation to achieve high success in hazardous terrain navigation and transfer to physics simulation.
tldr_zh: LEAP提出了一种四足导航方法，通过任务压力本身学习涌现的主动感知，利用凝视不变的自我中心信念表征，在危险地形导航中取得高成功率，并能迁移到物理仿真。

title: The Latent That Never Was: A Forensic Re-run of the CVAE Ablation in Action Chunking Transformers
summary: Action Chunking Transformers (ACT) are widely used to learn robot manipulation from demonstrations. Their conditional variational autoencoder includes an encoder meant to capture differences between demonstrations during training. The original ACT paper reported that encoder removal dropped the mean success rate from 35% to 2% on two simulated tasks with human demonstrations. We re-ran this ablation in the original code and checked whether the findings depend on the implementation or training data. The published drop does not reappear in our tests, although smaller gains or losses in success rate remain uncertain. To investigate the discrepancy, we varied training length and how checkpoints are selected for evaluation. Both can reverse which policy scores higher, but the published drop's cause remains unknown. Success rates alone leave open whether the encoder provides information that helps the policy reconstruct demonstrated actions. On the tested ACT benchmark, the sampled latent provides little reconstruction benefit at every tested nonzero weight of the penalty on latent information. At inference, ACT leaves this latent unused and sets it to zero. Skipping the encoder increases training throughput in both implementations we timed. We release code, evaluation tools and results so others can repeat the comparisons and test the encoder on other tasks.
summary_zh: 动作分块变换器（ACT）被广泛用于从示教中学习机器人操作技能。其条件变分自编码器包含一个编码器，旨在训练过程中捕捉示教之间的差异。原始ACT论文报告称，在两项使用人工示教的模拟任务中，移除编码器会使平均成功率从35%下降至2%。我们在原始代码中重新进行了这一消融实验，并检验了该结论是否依赖于具体实现或训练数据。在我们的测试中，论文中报告的下降并未重现，尽管成功率的小幅提升或下降仍存在不确定性。为探究这一差异，我们改变了训练时长以及用于评估的检查点选择方式。这两者均可能反转两种策略的相对优劣，但论文中所述下降的原因仍不明确。仅凭成功率无法判断编码器是否提供了有助于策略重建示教动作的信息。在所使用的ACT基准测试中，在对潜在信息惩罚项的所有非零权重设置下，采样得到的潜在变量对重建的益处均微乎其微。在推理阶段，ACT并未使用该潜在变量，而是将其设为零。在我们计时的两种实现中，跳过编码器均提高了训练吞吐量。我们公开了代码、评估工具及结果，以便他人重复上述比较，并在其他任务上测试编码器的作用。
tldr: This paper re-runs the CVAE ablation for Action Chunking Transformers and finds the originally reported dramatic performance drop does not reproduce, questioning the necessity of the latent encoder.
tldr_zh: 本文重新运行了动作分块变换器中的CVAE消融实验，发现原始报告的性能大幅下降无法复现，质疑了潜在编码器的必要性。

title: The Robot Data Factory
summary: Physical AI requires more than increasingly large robot datasets: intelligent robots acquire knowledge through continuous interaction with the physical world. We argue that the defining scientific resource of Physical AI is therefore not raw robot data alone, but robot experience - physically grounded interaction whose observations, actions, embodiment, context, and outcomes preserve the perception-action-consequence loop. We introduce the Robot Data Factory (RDF), a mission-driven infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing such experience. RDF organizes heterogeneous robots and environment-specific training grounds through reproducible missions, skill curricula, synchronized multimodal sensing, external ground truth, an agentic robot network, data pipelines, and living benchmarks. Rather than treating datasets as static end products, RDF implements a closed Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat cycle in which validated physical experience supports world models, vision-language-action models, embodied policies, digital twins, and subsequent robot deployment. We further formalize robot experience and its quality, introduce a mission-task-skill-episode-dataset-benchmark-capability hierarchy, and derive quantitative scaling laws and an algorithmic synthesis procedure connecting robot fleet size, sensor rates, storage, learning representations, tokenization, training compute, inference, and latency to Embodied-AI cluster requirements. The framework is instantiated in three complementary physical training grounds for domestic, environmental, and energy applications. RDF thus reframes robot data generation as a continuous scientific production process and provides a pathway toward reproducible, scalable, and eventually federated infrastructure for Physical AI.
summary_zh: 物理人工智能的需求远不止于日益庞大的机器人数据集：智能机器人通过持续与物理世界互动来获取知识。我们主张，物理人工智能的核心科学资源因此并非仅仅是原始机器人数据，而是机器人的经验——即物理实体的交互，其观测、动作、具身形态、情境及结果共同维系了感知-行动-后果的闭环。为此，我们提出了机器人数据工厂（RDF），这是一种以任务为导向的基础设施与方法论，用于持续生成、验证、基准测试并复用此类经验。RDF通过可复现的任务、技能课程、同步多模态感知、外部真值、智能体机器人网络、数据流水线及动态基准，整合异构机器人与特定环境的训练场地。RDF并未将数据集视为静态的最终产物，而是实施了一个闭环的“部署-测量-学习-重复”周期，在此周期中，经过验证的物理经验支撑起世界模型、视觉-语言-行动模型、具身策略、数字孪生及后续的机器人部署。我们进一步形式化了机器人经验及其质量，提出了任务-技能-片段-数据集-基准-能力的层级体系，并推导出定量缩放定律及一种算法合成流程，将机器人编队规模、传感器速率、存储、学习表征、分词处理、训练计算量、推理及延迟与具身AI集群需求相关联。该框架已在三个互补的物理训练场地中得到实际应用，分别面向家庭、环境及能源领域。由此，RDF将机器人数据生成重塑为一项持续的科学生产过程，并为物理人工智能提供了通向可复现、可扩展及最终联邦化基础设施的路径。
tldr: This paper proposes the Robot Data Factory (RDF), an infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing robot experience—physically grounded interaction data—to support the development of world models, VLA models, and embodied policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了机器人数据工厂（RDF），一种持续生成、验证、基准测试和重用机器人经验（物理接地交互数据）的基础设施和方法论，以支持世界模型、VLA模型和具身策略的开发。

title: IL-ACT: Imitation Learning with Adaptive Cartesian Tracking Control for a 30-ton Excavator
summary: Autonomous excavator control is challenged by coupled kinematics, actuation lag, and uncertainty. We propose imitation learning and adaptive Cartesian tracking (IL-ACT), a novel motion control framework for a 30-ton-class excavator. An anchored, 14-input imitation policy pretrained on operator demonstrations generates nominal joint rates; adaptive Cartesian feedback and gated gain/bias estimation correct these commands before a stopping-distance governor constrains joint-reference generation. Simscape evaluation covers 100 sequential goals and spiral, figure-eight, and rounded-raster tracking, including 88 additional runs across three training seeds, two initializations, and speeds, under hydraulic response and sensing conditions. Compared with Teacher+ACT, IL-ACT completes all goals with shorter duration and lower terminal errors under both response conditions. Telemetry-initialized IL-ACT lowers RMSE in all 24 figure-eight and rounded-raster seed comparisons and lowers additional-load spiral mean RMSE by approximately 29%. Original spiral RMSE also improves over IL-only and PID. Under a shared sensor-noise realization, telemetry-initialized IL-ACT achieves 27.67% lower mean RMSE than Teacher+ACT; enabling estimation reduces mean RMSE by $22.44\%$ relative to the frozen estimator. Pretrained-weight effects remain mixed, and the original teacher comparison exhibits a spiral RMSE--maximum-error tradeoff. Analysis establishes bounded adaptive states and Cartesian feedback, with reference admissibility conditional on governor feasibility.
summary_zh: 自主挖掘机控制面临耦合运动学、执行滞后和不确定性的挑战。我们提出模仿学习与自适应笛卡尔跟踪（IL-ACT），一种面向30吨级挖掘机的新型运动控制框架。基于操作员示范预训练的锚定14输入模仿策略生成标称关节速率；自适应笛卡尔反馈与门控增益/偏置估计在惯性距离调节器约束关节参考生成之前对这些指令进行修正。Simscape评估涵盖100个连续目标以及螺旋、八字形和圆角栅格轨迹跟踪，包括在液压响应和传感条件下跨三种训练种子、两种初始化和速度的88次附加运行。与Teacher+ACT相比，IL-ACT在两种响应条件下均以更短持续时间和更低终端误差完成所有目标。遥测初始化的IL-ACT在所有24次八字形和圆角栅格种子比较中降低RMSE，并将附加载荷螺旋平均RMSE降低约29%。原始螺旋RMSE也优于仅IL和PID方法。在共享传感器噪声实现下，遥测初始化的IL-ACT较Teacher+ACT实现27.67%的平均RMSE降低；启用估计相对于冻结估计器使平均RMSE降低22.44%。预训练权重的影响仍然不一，原始教师比较呈现螺旋RMSE与最大误差之间的权衡。分析确立了自适应状态和笛卡尔反馈的有界性，参考可容许性以调节器可行性为条件。
tldr: This paper presents IL-ACT, an imitation learning and adaptive Cartesian tracking control framework for a 30-ton excavator, demonstrating improved goal completion and tracking accuracy in simulation compared to baseline methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合模仿学习与自适应笛卡尔跟踪控制（IL-ACT）的框架，用于30吨级挖掘机的运动控制，并在仿真中相比基线方法实现了更好的目标完成率与跟踪精度。

title: Differentiable Mesh State Estimation via Factor Graph Inference for Deformable Object Reconstruction
summary: Estimating deformable object states remains a fundamental challenge in robotics and simulation. We propose a novel factor graph-based framework for probabilistic mesh state estimation of deformable objects. The method directly updates a tetrahedral mesh, a rich and physically-grounded representation of an environment, by combining physics priors, noisy sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness constraints within a unified probabilistic formulation. The estimation problem is posed as a nonlinear least-squares optimization and solved using Levenberg-Marquardt. Ex vivo central-airway obstruction experiments and simulations on deforming cube models demonstrate reliable and accurate reconstruction under both rigid motion and deformation, highlighting the potential of this probabilistic approach for principled, measurement-driven mesh state estimation in deformable object reconstruction.
summary_zh: 变形物体状态估计仍然是机器人学和仿真领域的一项基本挑战。我们提出了一种新颖的基于因子图的框架，用于对变形物体进行概率网格状态估计。该方法通过将物理先验、含噪传感器测量以及时间平滑约束统一纳入概率公式中，直接更新四面体网格，这是一种丰富且具有物理基础的环境表示形式。该估计问题被构建为非线性最小二乘优化，并采用列文伯格-马夸尔特算法求解。离体中央气道阻塞实验以及对变形立方体模型的仿真表明，该方法在刚体运动和变形情况下均能实现可靠且准确的 reconstruction，凸显了这种概率方法在变形物体重建中实现有原则的、以测量为驱动的网格状态估计的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a factor graph-based framework for probabilistic tetrahedral mesh state estimation of deformable objects, integrating physics priors, sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness in a nonlinear least-squares optimization solved via Levenberg-Marquardt. The method is validated on ex vivo airway obstruction experiments and deforming cube simulations, demonstrating reliable reconstruction under deformation and rigid motion.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于因子图的概率框架，用于可变形物体的四面体网格状态估计，将物理先验、传感器测量和时间平滑性整合为非线性最小二乘优化问题，并使用Levenberg-Marquardt求解。在体外气道阻塞实验和变形立方体模拟中的结果显示了在变形和刚体运动下可靠的重建性能。

title: Geometry vs Structure: Graph-Based Diagnostics for LiDAR Point-Cloud Simulation Fidelity
summary: Digital twins provide a scalable and cost-effective complement to real-world testing for validating autonomous-driving and advanced driver-assistance system (ADAS) sensor pipelines. However, quantifying their fidelity remains challenging, particularly for 3D LiDAR point clouds, where conventional geometric metrics may overlook important structural discrepancies. We present a graph-based framework for evaluating the structural fidelity of simulated LiDAR point clouds against real-world scans. While scan-level metrics such as Chamfer distance capture point-wise geometric similarity, they do not explicitly represent connectivity, topology, or object-level organization. Our framework constructs graphs from real and simulated point clouds, applies Louvain community detection to identify spatially coherent subgraphs, and matches corresponding communities using centroid proximity. For each matched pair, we compute $r_λ$, a bounded graph-spectral metric motivated by Weyl's inequality, and compare it with density-aware Chamfer distance (CDC) as a geometric baseline. Controlled perturbation experiments demonstrate that $r_λ$ is invariant to rigid transformations and robust to sensor noise while remaining sensitive to structural deformation. We evaluate the framework on 50 paired real and simulated LiDAR scans acquired using a Velodyne VLP-32C sensor and CARLA, respectively. The dataset contains more than 1,000 matched communities across four representative classes: vehicles, vegetation, trees, and building walls. The results show that geometric and structural measures capture complementary aspects of simulation fidelity, supporting graph-spectral analysis as an additional diagnostic layer for validating digital twins in ADAS and autonomous-driving applications.
summary_zh: 数字孪生为自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）传感器管线的实车测试提供了一种可扩展且成本效益高的补充手段。然而，量化其保真度仍具挑战性，尤其是在3D LiDAR点云方面，传统几何度量可能忽略重要的结构差异。我们提出了一种基于图的框架，用于评估仿真LiDAR点云相对于真实扫描数据的结构保真度。尽管扫描级度量（如Chamfer距离）能够捕捉逐点的几何相似性，但它们并未显式表示连通性、拓扑结构或对象级组织。我们的框架从真实和仿真点云中构建图，应用Louvain社区检测算法识别空间连贯的子图，并通过质心邻近性匹配对应的社区。对于每对匹配的社区，我们计算$r_λ$——一种受Weyl不等式启发的有界图谱度量，并将其与密度感知Chamfer距离（CDC）作为几何基线进行比较。受控扰动实验表明，$r_λ$对刚性变换具有不变性，对传感器噪声具有鲁棒性，同时保持对结构变形的敏感性。我们在分别使用Velodyne VLP-32C传感器和CARLA采集的50对真实与仿真LiDAR扫描数据上评估了该框架。该数据集包含超过1,000个匹配社区，涵盖四类代表性目标：车辆、植被、树木和建筑墙体。结果表明，几何度量与结构度量捕捉了仿真保真度的互补方面，支持将图谱分析作为验证ADAS和自动驾驶应用中数字孪生的额外诊断层。
tldr: This paper introduces a graph-based framework using spectral metrics and community detection to evaluate the structural fidelity of simulated LiDAR point clouds against real scans, demonstrating that geometric and structural measures complement each other for validating digital twins in ADAS and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于图和谱度量的框架，用于评估模拟LiDAR点云与真实扫描的结构保真度，并证明几何与结构度量在ADAS和自动驾驶数字孪生验证中互补。

title: UDAV: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate routes directly from aerial imagery for off-road navigation, but their predictions provide no indication of reliability. We present UDAV, an Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner for UAV-guided UGV navigation. UDAV draws multiple stochastic trajectory predictions, selects their medoid as a self-consistent nominal route, and estimates predictive uncertainty from their spatial dispersion. When the maximum uncertainty across interior waypoints exceeds a threshold, UDAV invokes a reconsideration stage; otherwise, it returns the medoid directly. We evaluate UDAV on 400 held-out trajectory queries from two UAV flights. Stochastic medoid selection reduces the mean average displacement error (ADE) from 147.4 pixels for a deterministic prediction to 115.9 pixels. The complete planner achieves a mean ADE of 110.4 pixels, a 25.1% reduction relative to deterministic planning, while producing valid trajectories for all queries. UDAV also yields the lowest 90th- and 95th-percentile errors among all evaluated configurations, including a higher-budget K=10 consensus baseline. Relative to the K=5 medoid, UDAV reduces these errors from 225.3 and 326.0 pixels to 199.0 and 290.8 pixels, respectively. These results demonstrate that stochastic VLM predictions provide both a stronger nominal route and an actionable uncertainty signal for selectively mitigating large planning errors.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）可直接根据航拍图像为越野导航生成路径，但其预测结果并未提供可靠性指示。我们提出UDAV，一种面向无人机引导无人地面车辆导航的不确定性驱动的自适应VLM航路点规划器。UDAV生成多条随机轨迹预测，选取其中心点作为自洽的名义路线，并根据这些预测的空间离散程度估计预测不确定性。当内部航路点的最大不确定性超过阈值时，UDAV启动重新考虑阶段；否则，直接返回中心点轨迹。我们在两次无人机飞行的400条留出轨迹查询上评估UDAV。随机中心点选择将平均位移误差（ADE）从确定性预测的147.4像素降至115.9像素。完整规划器实现了110.4像素的平均ADE，相比确定性规划降低了25.1%，同时为所有查询生成了有效轨迹。在所有评估配置中，UDAV还实现了最低的第90和第95百分位误差，其中包括更高预算的K=10共识基线。相对于K=5中心点方法，UDAV将这些误差分别从225.3和326.0像素降至199.0和290.8像素。这些结果表明，随机VLM预测既提供了更强的名义路线，也提供了可操作的不确定性信号，用于选择性地缓解较大的规划误差。
tldr: UDAV improves VLM-based waypoint planning for off-road UAV-guided UGV navigation by drawing multiple stochastic trajectory predictions, selecting their medoid as a nominal route, and using predictive uncertainty to trigger a reconsideration stage, reducing mean ADE by 25.1%.
tldr_zh: UDAV 通过从多个随机轨迹预测中选择中值作为标称路线，并利用预测不确定性触发重新考虑阶段，提高了基于 VLM 的越野无人机引导无人车航路规划，将平均 ADE 降低了 25.1%。

title: ConGraspXL: Controllable Constraint-Conditioned Dexterous Grasping Motion Synthesis
summary: Dexterous grasping is usually conducted for specific tasks, leading to heterogeneous constraints such as specific approach directions, desired contact regions, specified wrist trajectories, and functional hand poses. Our previous work, GraspXL, achieves scalable grasping motion synthesis for diverse objects and hand morphologies, while lacking controllability for synthesis under such various task-driven constraints. In this paper, we propose ConGraspXL, which extends GraspXL with controllable constraint-conditioned grasp motion synthesis that accommodates diverse task-driven constraints and their combinations. We introduce a hierarchical constraint formulation, enable flexible constraint composition with a masked residual interface, and improve control precision with dynamic hand centers and feed-forward wrist guidance. Without losing the strong generalization capabilities of GraspXL, ConGraspXL enables precise and flexible controllability for various individual constraints and their combinations, providing a plug-and-play low-level grasp controller for downstream applications such as whole-body grasp completion, functional grasping, and human-motion imitation.
summary_zh: 灵巧抓取通常针对特定任务进行，这使得抓取过程受到多种异构约束的影响，例如特定的接近方向、期望的接触区域、指定的手腕轨迹以及功能性手部姿态。我们此前的工作GraspXL实现了针对多样物体和手部形态的可扩展抓取动作合成，但在上述多种任务驱动约束下缺乏可控性。为此，本文提出ConGraspXL，在GraspXL的基础上扩展出可控约束条件下的抓取动作合成能力，以适配多种任务驱动约束及其组合。我们引入了一种层次化约束表示，通过掩码残差接口实现灵活的约束组合，并借助动态手部中心和前馈手腕引导提升了控制精度。ConGraspXL在保持GraspXL强大泛化能力的同时，能够对各种单独约束及其组合实现精确、灵活的控制，为下游应用（如全身抓取完成、功能性抓取以及人体动作模仿）提供了一种即插即用的底层抓取控制器。
tldr: ConGraspXL extends a generalizable dexterous grasping motion synthesis model with a hierarchical constraint formulation and masked residual interface, enabling controllable constraint-conditioned grasping under various task-driven constraints while maintaining generalization.
tldr_zh: ConGraspXL在通用灵巧抓取运动合成模型的基础上，引入分层约束建模和掩码残差接口，支持多种任务约束下的可控抓取运动生成，同时保持强泛化能力。

title: NeuroSymbEAD: A Large Scale Neuro-Symbolic Caption Dataset for Omni-Directional Embodied Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper introduces NeuroSymbEAD, a large-scale neuro-symbolic caption dataset featuring an ego-centric knowledge graph (KG) of static and dynamic objects annotated with classes, categories, heading directions, orientations, and distances from the ego-vehicle. These annotations are used on the KITTI-360 dataset to generate multilevel textual captions representing a lightweight version of an ego-centric scene map. Outdoor scene-map reconstruction, visual recognition, and object grounding establish baselines for driving common sense and traffic/scene understanding. For these purposes, natural language-based grounded captioning of objects and their complex relationships is a widely adopted contextual representation for indoor scene tasks. Neuro-symbolic representations have proven effective in handling structured information for various computer vision and language applications. Our data annotation pipeline allows the generation of varied map segments, populating simulated or real objects within the bounding boxes predicted by any 3D object detection network, and building hierarchical text captions. We benchmark our neuro-symbolic and ontological caption generation using pre-trained grounding and learned auto-regressive captioning networks. By converting 3D driving scenes into structured ego-centric language, NeuroSymbEAD provides a benchmark for vision-language and foundation models for traffic-scene explanation, 3D reasoning, and interpretable autonomous-driving perception.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了NeuroSymbEAD，这是一个大规模的神经符号字幕数据集，其特点是以自我为中心的知识图谱（KG），包含静态和动态对象的类别、分类、朝向方向、方位及与自我车辆的距离等标注信息。这些标注应用于KITTI-360数据集，以生成多层次的文本字幕，从而构建轻量级的自我中心场景地图表示。室外场景地图重建、视觉识别和对象锚定，为驾驶常识及交通/场景理解建立了基线。针对这些目标，基于自然语言的对象的锚定字幕及其复杂关系，是室内场景任务中被广泛采用的上下文表示方法。神经符号表示已被证明在处理各种计算机视觉和语言应用的结构化信息方面效果显著。我们的数据标注流水线能够生成多样的地图片段，在任意3D目标检测网络预测的边界框内填充模拟或真实对象，并构建分层的文本字幕。我们利用预训练的锚定网络和学习型自回归字幕生成网络，对我们的神经符号和本体论字幕生成进行了基准测试。通过将3D驾驶场景转换为结构化的自我中心语言，NeuroSymbEAD为视觉-语言及基础模型在交通场景解释、3D推理和可解释的自动驾驶感知方面提供了基准。
tldr: Introduces a large-scale neuro-symbolic caption dataset on KITTI-360 with ego-centric knowledge graphs and hierarchical textual captions for traffic-scene explanation and interpretable autonomous-driving perception, benchmarking grounding and captioning networks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个基于KITTI-360的大规模神经符号字幕数据集，包含自我中心知识图谱和分层文本描述，用于交通场景解释和可解释的自动驾驶感知，并评测了基础模型和字幕生成网络。

title: Gaussian Processes for Modelling Spatial Fields with Robot Swarms
summary: Robot swarms, by virtue of their decentralised architecture, are a natural tool for scalable, robust modelling of spatial fields, such as water temperature, wind velocity, or terrain elevation. However, existing methods rely on external positioning systems that allow each robot to determine its own position in space. Here, we introduce location-unaware Gaussian process regression (LU-GPR) as a solution to the modelling of spatial fields in the absence of such positioning systems. LU-GPR allows each robot to infer the posterior mean and variance of the field in space, while simultaneously agreeing on a common frame of reference with its peers, using only local sensing and communication. We propose an online algorithm that allows each robot to consistently infer local estimates as its local frame of reference converges to the common one. By means of a product of experts model, each robot also combines the estimates of its peers with its own to obtain a global model. Our results show that LU-GPR scales well with the number of robots and is robust to limited communication ranges. We also demonstrate how it can be used in real-world monitoring scenarios to estimate the flow of an evacuating crowd.
summary_zh: 机器人群体凭借其去中心化的架构，天然适用于对空间场（如水温、风速或地形高程）进行可扩展且稳健的建模。然而，现有方法依赖于外部定位系统，使每个机器人能够确定其自身在空间中的位置。在此，我们提出了一种无需位置感知的高斯过程回归（LU-GPR）方法，以解决在缺乏此类定位系统时的空间场建模问题。LU-GPR允许每个机器人在仅使用局部感知和通信的条件下，推断空间场的后验均值和方差，同时与同伴达成共同的参考坐标系。我们提出了一种在线算法，使每个机器人能够在其局部参考坐标系收敛到共同坐标系的过程中，持续推断局部估计值。通过专家乘积模型，每个机器人还将同伴的估计与其自身估计相结合，以获得全局模型。结果表明，LU-GPR在机器人数量增加时具有良好的扩展性，并且对有限通信范围具有鲁棒性。我们还展示了该方法在真实世界监测场景中估算疏散人群流动的应用。
tldr: This paper introduces location-unaware Gaussian process regression (LU-GPR) for robot swarms to model spatial fields without external positioning, using local sensing and communication to agree on a common reference frame.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了无需位置感知的高斯过程回归（LU-GPR），使机器人群体在没有外部定位系统的情况下，仅通过局部感知和通信来建模空间场并共同确定参考系。

title: RobResilience: Implementing and Evaluating a Resilience Framework for Cyber-Physical Embodied Systems
summary: In embodied cyber-physical systems, active cyberattacks pose an immediate threat not just to data, but to physical integrity and human safety. While existing security approaches excel at detection, they lack the runtime mechanisms to determine whether a disruption is tolerable or if performance degradation remains within safe operational bounds. This gap leaves autonomous systems vulnerable to graceful failure paralysis, where they cannot distinguish between a safe, degraded state and a catastrophic hazard during an ongoing attack. This paper presents RobResilience, an implementation of a formal resilience framework for embodied cyber-physical systems in a Webots simulation environment, using a PR2 robot and ROS2. The framework evaluates three predicates at runtime: tolerable disruption ($δ$), tolerable degradation ($γ$), and mitigation feasibility ($μ$), over a compromised device set derived from IDS confidence scores.
