tldr_zh: DetAug 提出了一种障碍盲轨迹增强方法，通过将增强参数作为条件标签并在推理时选择低碰撞轨迹，在 SafeLIBERO 和真实硬件上实现了强大的零样本避障能力。

title: DistAL: Distance-based Advantage Learning for VLA Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have trans- formed the field of robotic manipulation in recent years by combining the semantic understanding of LLMs with the precise control of flow-matching policies. Advantage conditioning is a recent technique that iteratively improves VLAs by training a value function on deployment data and using this to train an advantage-conditioned policy. Previous works have only applied simple, low-information success/failure rewards, which leave the value function unable to distinguish states of differing quality beyond how far along the task they appear. Motivated by an exploration of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods, we introduce Distance-based Advantage Learning (DistAL), which, by using an embedding space distance as a reward, produces a more informative value function and subsequently a higher downstream task success rate. We validate our method on a series of simulation benchmarks and dexterous bi-manual manipulation tasks on real hardware.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）近年来通过将大型语言模型（LLMs）的语义理解与流匹配策略的精确控制相结合，彻底改变了机器人操作领域。优势条件化是近期兴起的一项技术，它通过在部署数据上训练价值函数，并利用该函数训练优势条件化策略，从而迭代式地改进VLA模型。以往的研究仅采用简单、信息量低的成功/失败奖励，这使得价值函数无法区分除任务进展程度之外的状态质量差异。受离分布（OOD）检测方法探索的启发，我们提出了基于距离的优势学习（DistAL），该方法通过利用嵌入空间距离作为奖励，产生更具信息量的价值函数，进而提升下游任务的成功率。我们在系列仿真基准测试以及真实硬件上的灵巧双臂操作任务中验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: DistAL improves VLA fine-tuning by using embedding-space distance as a reward signal for advantage conditioning, yielding more informative value functions and higher success rates on simulation and real dexterous bi-manual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: DistAL 通过使用嵌入空间距离作为奖励信号进行优势条件化，改进了 VLA 微调，从而产生更信息丰富的价值函数，并在仿真和真实灵巧双手机器人操作任务上获得了更高的成功率。

title: Decoupling Vision, Language, and Action for Efficient Multi-Task Robot Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies commonly run Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones with billions of parameters at every policy inference, which costs latency and energy. We revisit a decoupled alternative for multi-task manipulation: separate vision and language encoders whose representations condition a compact action head. We run a standardized comparison that varies the vision encoder, the language encoder, and the action head while holding the demonstrations, the training-step budget, the tasks, the evaluation protocol, and the measurement platform fixed, against seven VLA baselines. The resulting Decoupled Embodiment Model (DEM) combines a fine-tuned DINOv3 vision encoder, a frozen NeoBERT language encoder, and a MeanFlow head that generates an action chunk in one forward pass. On 18 RoboCasa tasks evaluated with held-out instruction paraphrases and randomized scenes, DEM reaches 55.6\% mean success against 56.9\% for GR00T N1.7 and 54.6\% for $π_{0.5}$, and on three real-robot tasks it reaches 66.0\% against 68.0\% for GR00T N1.7. On the same workstation, DEM needs 6.1\,ms per policy forward pass, a maximum throughput of 162.7 policy calls per second, and draws an estimated 2.07\,J of GPU energy per call, eight to seventeen times the throughput and six to fifteen times less energy than these VLM-backbone policies. Within this trained-task regime, DEM sits on the observed success--latency--energy frontier and provides a strong, efficient baseline for language-conditioned robot skills.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常在每次策略推理时运行具有数十亿参数的视觉-语言模型（VLM）主干网络，这带来了延迟和能耗成本。我们重新审视了一种用于多任务操作的解耦替代方案：将独立的视觉和语言编码器分离，其表示用于条件化一个紧凑的动作头。我们在保持演示数据、训练步数预算、任务、评估协议和测量平台固定的前提下，进行了标准化比较，变化视觉编码器、语言编码器和动作头，并与七个VLA基线进行对比。由此产生的解耦具身模型（DEM）结合了微调后的DINOv3视觉编码器、冻结的NeoBERT语言编码器以及一个在前向传播中生成动作块的MeanFlow头。在18个RoboCasa任务上，使用保留的指令改写和随机化场景进行评估，DEM的平均成功率达到55.6%，而GR00T N1.7为56.9%，π₀.₅为54.6%；在三个真实机器人任务上，DEM达到66.0%，而GR00T N1.7为68.0%。在同一工作站上，DEM每次策略前向传播仅需6.1毫秒，最大吞吐量达到每秒162.7次策略调用，每次调用估计消耗2.07焦耳的GPU能量，其吞吐量是这些VLM主干策略的八到十七倍，能耗仅为后者的六分之一到十五分之一。在已训练任务的范围内，DEM位于观测到的成功率-延迟-能耗前沿，为语言条件化的机器人技能提供了一个强大且高效的基线。
tldr: This paper proposes a decoupled vision-language-action architecture for multi-task robot manipulation, achieving comparable success to large VLA baselines with significantly higher throughput and lower energy consumption.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种解耦的视觉-语言-动作架构用于多任务机器人操作，在成功率上与大型VLA基线相当，但吞吐量更高、能耗更低。

title: GraphPoint: Semantic Entity Graphs and Point Trajectories for Compositional Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot manipulation policies often struggle to generalize beyond their demonstrations, even when new instructions involve familiar objects and behaviors. When language and scenes are strongly correlated during training, a policy can learn a fixed visual-action mapping rather than respond to the requested behavior. We investigate compositional reuse at two levels: within a subtask, combining familiar entities, action types, and action modifiers; and across subtasks, reusing learned subtasks in unseen long-horizon tasks. We introduce CoMani, a benchmark with controlled splits for evaluating both capabilities. Matched initial scenes and controlled changes to a single semantic factor encourage reliance on language rather than visual shortcuts. We further propose GraphPoint, which connects semantic entity graphs to geometric control by predicting future gripper point trajectories and converting them into actions using robot geometry. The framework organizes the gripper and objects by semantic roles and conditions their interactions on action types and modifiers, while predicted progress guides transitions during execution. Experiments and ablations on CoMani validate the effectiveness of our method for instruction-dependent generalization at both levels. Code will be released at GraphPoint.
summary_zh: 机器人操控策略常常难以在演示之外进行泛化，即使新指令涉及熟悉的物体和行为也是如此。当训练过程中语言与场景高度相关时，策略可能学习到固定的视觉-动作映射，而非响应所请求的行为。我们从两个层面研究组合重用：在子任务内部，组合熟悉的实体、动作类型和动作修饰符；在子任务之间，在未见过的长时程任务中重用已学习的子任务。我们引入了CoMani，一个具有受控划分的基准，用于评估这两种能力。匹配的初始场景以及对单一语义因子的受控变更，鼓励模型依赖语言而非视觉捷径。我们进一步提出了GraphPoint，该方法通过将语义实体图与几何控制相连接，预测未来的夹爪点轨迹，并利用机器人几何结构将其转换为动作。该框架按语义角色组织夹爪和物体，并根据动作类型和修饰符调节它们之间的交互，同时预测的进度在执行过程中引导状态转换。在CoMani上的实验和消融研究验证了我们的方法在指令依赖泛化方面两个层面的有效性。代码将在GraphPoint发布。
tldr: This paper introduces CoMani, a benchmark for compositional robot manipulation, and GraphPoint, a method that uses semantic entity graphs and gripper point trajectories to improve instruction-dependent generalization in robot manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于组合机器人操作的基准CoMani，以及GraphPoint方法，该方法利用语义实体图和夹持器点轨迹来改进机器人操作策略的指令依赖泛化能力。

title: ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning
summary: Underwater visuomotor policy learning has focused primarily on single manipulators, while bimanual imitation learning has been studied largely in air. We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform. We investigate how learning methods and execution strategies developed for manipulation in air perform underwater, examining bubble disturbances, buoyancy-driven object motion, action-execution horizons, and real-time chunking. A separate single-arm study examines policy transfer between air and water and shows that demonstrations spanning both media support execution in both under the tested conditions. ULOHA provides a unified experimental platform for studying underwater bimanual robot learning under the coupled perceptual and physical effects of underwater environments. Additional material: https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/
summary_zh: 水下视觉运动策略学习主要聚焦于单机械臂，而双臂模仿学习则主要在空中环境中研究。我们提出了ULOHA，一个水下双臂机器人学习平台，它结合了定制的主从硬件与LeRobot的软件扩展，集成了遥操作、多视角感知、示教收集、策略训练和自主部署等功能。真实机器人实验展示了一系列协调的水下双臂行为，包括臂间传递、共享物体操作以及浮力驱动的拦截任务。我们在该平台上评估了ACT、扩散策略以及视觉-语言-动作模型SmolVLA。我们探究了为空中操作开发的学习方法和执行策略在水下环境中的表现，考察了气泡扰动、浮力驱动的物体运动、动作执行时域以及实时分块等因素。一项单独的单臂研究探讨了策略在空气和水之间的迁移，结果表明涵盖两种介质的示教数据在测试条件下能够支持在两种环境中的执行。ULOHA为研究水下环境中耦合感知与物理效应下的双臂机器人学习提供了一个统一的实验平台。更多资料：https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/
tldr: ULOHA is an underwater bimanual robot learning platform with custom leader-follower hardware and LeRobot software extensions, enabling teleoperation, multi-view sensing, and autonomous deployment of coordinated bimanual behaviors. It evaluates ACT, Diffusion Policy, and SmolVLA, investigating how air-developed methods transfer to underwater conditions and demonstrating cross-media policy transfer.
tldr_zh: ULOHA 是一个水下双臂机器人学习平台，结合定制主从硬件和 LeRobot 软件扩展，支持遥操作、多视角感知和自主部署协调的双臂行为。它在水下条件下评估 ACT、扩散策略和 SmolVLA，研究空气环境开发的方法如何迁移到水下，并展示了跨介质策略迁移。

title: Function-Preserving Data Generation for Zero-Shot Real-to-Sim-to-Real Manipulation
summary: Robotic data generation is a promising paradigm for scaling robot learning without collecting large-scale real-world data. However, generating geometrically diverse yet physically valid data for contact-rich tasks remains challenging, especially when success depends on precise geometric interfaces. Standard shape augmentation methods often distort task-critical interfaces, resulting in invalid contact relationships, e.g., fit mismatches or interpenetration, rendering downstream interactions infeasible. To address these limitations, we propose a function-preserving Real-to-Sim-to-Real framework that generates synthetic demonstrations from reconstructed assets without teleoperated source trajectories. Our method augments task-relevant object geometries through constraint-guided mesh deformation, together with physically consistent transfer of task poses and collision proxies. Visual domain randomization is further applied during simulation rollouts, enabling robust zero-shot policy deployment without real-world fine-tuning. Extensive experiments in both real-world and simulation settings demonstrate that our method enables robust generalization across unseen object geometries and diverse visual conditions in contact-rich and long-horizon tasks. Our method provides a practical path toward scalable robot learning for contact-rich tasks via shape deformation.
summary_zh: 机器人数据生成是一种很有前景的范式，可以在无需收集大规模真实世界数据的情况下扩展机器人学习。然而，为接触密集任务生成几何多样且物理有效的数据仍然具有挑战性，尤其是当任务成功依赖于精确的几何接口时。标准形状增广方法往往扭曲任务关键接口，导致无效的接触关系（例如配合不匹配或相互穿透），从而使后续交互不可行。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种保持功能的Real-to-Sim-to-Real框架，该框架无需遥操作源轨迹即可从重建资产中生成合成演示。我们的方法通过约束引导的网格变形来增强任务相关物体的几何形状，同时实现任务姿态和碰撞代理的物理一致性迁移。在仿真 rollout 过程中还应用了视觉域随机化，从而无需真实世界微调即可实现鲁棒的零样本策略部署。在真实世界和仿真环境中的大量实验表明，我们的方法能够在接触密集和长时程任务中，对未见过的物体几何形状和多样的视觉条件实现鲁棒泛化。我们的方法为通过形状变形实现接触密集任务的可扩展机器人学习提供了一条实用路径。
tldr: This paper proposes a function-preserving Real-to-Sim-to-Real framework that augments task-relevant object geometries via constraint-guided mesh deformation and generates synthetic demonstrations for contact-rich manipulation, enabling zero-shot policy deployment on unseen objects and visual conditions without real-world fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种保函数的 Real-to-Sim-to-Real 框架，通过约束引导的网格变形增强任务相关物体几何，并生成接触丰富操作的合成演示，使策略能够在未见物体和视觉条件下零样本部署，无需真实世界微调。

title: Acting in Meters: Learning Metric Interactions for Precise Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action models and World-Action Models have advanced language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet often leave metric relations among actions, objects, and scene geometry implicit. Human manipulation combines semantic understanding of task-relevant objects with spatial feedback that guides hand motion relative to objects and their surroundings. Inspired by this, we introduce a metric interaction framework that models object-level and scene-level interactions in physical Cartesian space at a shared metric scale. At the object level, Interaction-Centric Tokens (ICTs) explicitly represent end-effector pose trajectories relative to manipulated objects and are jointly denoised with actions, providing physically grounded interaction supervision. At the scene level, the Metric Action Interaction Field (MAIF) uses action and ICT queries to attend to metric scene point-cloud features and learns geometry-conditioned action corrections. Through two-stage adaptation, our framework improves diverse VLA and WAM baselines with a small number of additional parameters and training steps. Experiments demonstrate average success-rate gains of 0.80 and 3.59 percentage points on LIBERO and RoboTwin~2.0, respectively, alongside gains of 6.80 percentage points on real-world tasks and 7.45 percentage points on their out-of-distribution variants.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型和世界行动模型推动了语言条件机器人操作的发展，但这些模型往往将动作、物体与场景几何之间的度量关系隐式化。人类操作结合了对任务相关物体的语义理解，以及引导手部相对于物体及其周围环境运动的空间反馈。受此启发，我们提出一种度量交互框架，该框架在物理笛卡尔空间中以共享的度量尺度对物体级和场景级交互进行建模。在物体层面，交互中心令牌（ICTs）显式地表示相对于被操作物体的末端执行器姿态轨迹，并与动作联合去噪，从而提供具有物理基础的交互监督。在场景层面，度量动作交互场（MAIF）利用动作和ICT查询来关注度量场景点云特征，并学习基于几何条件的动作修正。通过两阶段适配，我们的框架以少量额外参数和训练步骤提升了多种VLA和WAM基线的性能。实验结果表明，在LIBERO和RoboTwin~2.0上平均成功率分别提升了0.80和3.59个百分点，在真实世界任务上提升了6.80个百分点，在其分布外变体上提升了7.45个百分点。
tldr: This paper introduces a metric interaction framework with Interaction-Centric Tokens (ICTs) and a Metric Action Interaction Field (MAIF) to improve VLA and World-Action Models for robotic manipulation by explicitly modeling object-level and scene-level interactions in metric Cartesian space, achieving consistent success-rate gains across benchmarks and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种度量交互框架，通过交互中心令牌（ICTs）和度量动作交互场（MAIF）在物理笛卡尔空间中以共享度量尺度显式建模物体级和场景级交互，从而提升VLA和世界动作模型在机器人操作中的性能，并在多个基准和真实任务中取得稳定成功率提升。

title: CANTABILE: Learning Expressive Dynamics for Robotic Piano Performance
summary: Robotic piano playing has emerged as a standard benchmark for dexterous bimanual manipulation, yet progress on it has been measured almost entirely by note accuracy -- which keys are pressed (pitch) and when (onset) -- leaving the musical dynamics essential for expressive performance neither rewarded nor evaluated. We propose CANTABILE, a dynamics-aware framework for robotic piano performance that (i) closes the score-to-contact loop by conditioning the policy on upcoming velocity goals and mapping each key's angular velocity at onset back to MIDI velocity, (ii) couples a velocity-fidelity reward with an onset-coverage reward, so that dynamics cannot be improved by omitting difficult notes, and (iii) refines a frozen dynamics-aware base policy with an alpha-scaled, finger-only residual that localizes strike-intensity adaptation away from nominal note execution. On EXPRESSIVE-51, a dynamics-rich 51-song subset of RoboPianist, CANTABILE raises Velocity F1 -- jointly measuring pitch, onset, and intensity within a +/-8 MIDI-velocity tolerance -- from 0.06 to 0.34 over the RoboPianist baseline, improves all 51 songs, more than halves matched-note velocity error, and reduces log-mel distance to reference audio by 8%. Intensity-randomized training further enables runtime control of performance intensity without retraining.
summary_zh: 机器人钢琴演奏已成为衡量灵巧双手操作能力的标准基准，然而该领域的进展几乎完全以音符准确性——即按下哪些键（音高）及何时按下（起始时间）——来评估，而对手富有表现力的演奏至关重要的音乐力度既未得到奖励，也未受到评价。我们提出了CANTABILE，一个面向机器人钢琴演奏的力度感知框架，该框架：（i）通过将策略条件设定为即将到来的速度目标，并将每个琴键在起始时刻的角速度映射回MIDI力度，从而闭合乐谱到接触的闭环；（ii）将力度保真奖励与起始覆盖奖励相结合，使得无法通过省略难弹音符来提升力度表现；（iii）利用alpha缩放且仅涉及手指的残差策略对冻结的力度感知基础策略进行细化，将击键强度适应局部化于名义音符执行之外。在EXPRESSIVE-51——RoboPianist中一个包含51首力度丰富歌曲的子集——上，CANTABILE将力度F1分数（在±8个MIDI力度容差内联合衡量音高、起始时间和强度）从RoboPianist基线的0.06提升至0.34，在全部51首歌曲上均有改善，匹配音符的力度误差减少一半以上，并将参考音频的对数梅尔距离降低8%。强度随机化训练进一步实现了无需重新训练即可对演奏强度进行运行时控制。
tldr: CANTABILE introduces a dynamics-aware framework for robotic piano performance, enhancing expressive dynamics such as key velocity while maintaining note accuracy, and enables runtime intensity control without retraining.
tldr_zh: CANTABILE提出了一个动力学感知的机器人钢琴演奏框架，在保持音符准确性的同时增强表达动力学（如按键速度），并支持无需重新训练即可实时控制演奏强度。

title: TacBPM: A Tactile-conditioned Behavior Prior Model for Dexterous Reorientation
summary: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires policies that coordinate high-DoF hand joints through intermittent, contact-rich interaction. Beyond target-orientation tracking, such policies must discover finger gaits that preserve object stability while adapting to geometry, anisotropy, pose, contact, and sensing changes. We propose \method, a tactile-conditioned behavior prior model for dexterous reorientation. \method distills multi-scale sphere specialists into a latent controller and lets downstream policies reuse the fixed tactile prior through residual latent actions, reducing renewed exploration from raw joint commands. The prior conditions on tactile-proprioceptive history so latent behavior reflects the current hand-object interaction. We evaluate arbitrary-pose transfer across anisotropic objects, commanded-axis rotation, and an arm-hand Grasp-to-AnyPose task in which the robot must grasp, lift, transport, and reach goal poses for novel tool geometries and generalized placements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method accelerates training and enables stable policies where matched raw-action PPO remains near failure, with successful sim-to-real transfer in in-hand and arm-hand tasks.
summary_zh: 灵巧的在手操作需要策略通过间歇性、接触丰富的交互协调高自由度手部关节。除了目标姿态跟踪，这类策略还必须发现手指步态，在适应几何、各向异性、姿态、接触和感知变化的同时保持物体稳定性。我们提出\method，一种用于灵巧重定向的触觉条件行为先验模型。\method将多尺度球面专家蒸馏为潜在控制器，并让下游策略通过残差潜在动作复用固定的触觉先验，从而减少从原始关节命令重新探索的需求。先验以触觉-本体感觉历史为条件，使潜在行为反映当前手-物体交互。我们评估了跨各向异性物体的任意姿态迁移、指定轴旋转，以及手臂-手部抓取到任意姿态任务，其中机器人必须为新颖的工具几何形状和泛化放置抓取、提升、运输并达到目标姿态。大量实验表明，所提方法加速了训练，并在匹配的原始动作PPO接近失败的情况下实现了稳定策略，同时在在手和手臂-手部任务中成功实现了仿真到现实的迁移。
tldr: TacBPM distills multi-scale sphere specialists into a tactile-conditioned behavior prior for dexterous in-hand reorientation, enabling downstream policies to reuse the prior via residual latent actions. It accelerates training and achieves sim-to-real transfer in in-hand and arm-hand manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: TacBPM 将多尺度球体专家蒸馏为触觉条件的行为先验模型，用于灵巧手内重定向，使下游策略通过残差潜在动作重用先验。它加速了训练，并在手内和手臂-手部操作任务中实现了仿真到现实的迁移。

title: Approximating High Dimensional Self-Motion Manifolds via Deep Generative Models
summary: Self-motion manifold (SMM) characterizes the geometric structure of the infinite inverse kinematic solutions set of a redundant manipulator at a fixed end-effector pose, and its efficient recovery underpins feasible and global optimal motion planning. Existing methods such as null-space continuation and learning-based methods are formulated around the assumption that an SMM is a curve, and do not extend to higher redundancy orders. We instead adopt a probabilistic view: SMMs are the support of the conditional posterior over configurations given a target pose, so that recovering it reduces to sampling from a learned distribution and separating its disjoint components by clustering. The formulation is independent of the manifold dimension and requires no architectural change as the redundancy order grows. In this work, we demonstrate that our method can approximate 1-D SMMs with performance comparable to the latest null-space continuation and learning-based approach, and that it is the first method capable of approximating highly redundant 4-D SMMs in a 7R manipulator for position tasks. Project website: \href{https://github.com/accuracy-maker/high-dimenstional-self-motion-manifold-approximation}{https://github.com/accuracy-maker/high-dimenstional-self-motion-manifold-approximation}
summary_zh: 自运动流形（SMM）描述了冗余机械臂在固定末端执行器位姿下无穷逆运动学解集的几何结构，对其高效恢复是可行且全局最优运动规划的基础。现有方法（如零空间延拓和基于学习的方法）均基于SMM为曲线的假设构建，无法推广至更高冗余阶次。我们转而采用概率视角：SMM是在给定目标位姿条件下配置后验分布的支撑集，因此恢复SMM可归结为从学习到的分布中采样，并通过聚类分离其不相交的分量。该公式与流形维度无关，且随着冗余阶次增长无需改变网络架构。在本工作中，我们证明该方法能够以与最新零空间延拓和基于学习方法相当的性能逼近一维SMM，并且是首个能够在7R机械臂位置任务中逼近高冗余四维SMM的方法。项目网站：\href{https://github.com/accuracy-maker/high-dimenstional-self-motion-manifold-approximation}{https://github.com/accuracy-maker/high-dimenstional-self-motion-manifold-approximation}
tldr: This paper proposes a probabilistic method using deep generative models to approximate high-dimensional self-motion manifolds (SMMs) for redundant manipulators, extending beyond traditional curve-based assumptions and enabling approximation of 4-D SMMs in a 7R robot for position tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于深度生成模型的概率方法，用于近似冗余机械臂的高维自运动流形（SMM），突破了传统曲线假设，首次实现了对7R机械臂位置任务中4维SMM的近似。

title: Fetch My Beer: Synthetic-to-real Hierarchical Policy for Smooth Pick-and-place
summary: Many real-world robotic applications require dynamically sensitive manipulation, where success depends not only on reaching a target state but on maintaining stable object dynamics throughout execution. We study the stable transport of liquid-filled containers, where a robot must move objects to target locations while suppressing sloshing and preventing spillage. Unlike conventional pick-and-place, this task imposes stringent requirements on motion smoothness and trajectory-level stability, exposing clear limitations in existing systems. Specifically, fluid simulation remains too costly for online reinforcement learning; human teleoperation introduces unintended accelerations that induce sloshing during imitation learning; and current policy pipelines optimize for task completion rather than dynamic stability. We propose a synthetic-to-real framework coupling physically validated data generation with a hierarchical, diffusion-based controller. The scalable data pipeline synthesizes grasps, filters unstable poses via a vision-language model, and validates transport trajectories through fluid simulation. The policy is organized with a high-level module that translates language and visual observations into SE(3) control targets, and a latent diffusion controller that first plans efficiently in a compact latent space and then decodes dense action chunks, enabling the high control frequency needed for smooth and stable motion. Extensive experiments show our system outperforms state-of-the-art manipulation policies in transport smoothness and dynamic stability. Our project page: https://fetch-my-beer.github.io/
summary_zh: 许多现实世界中的机器人应用要求具备动态敏感的操作能力，其成功不仅取决于达到目标状态，更依赖于在整个执行过程中维持稳定的物体动态。本文研究了装有液体的容器在运输过程中的稳定性问题，即机器人需在抑制液体晃动和防止泼洒的同时，将物体移动至目标位置。与传统的抓取-放置任务不同，该任务对运动的平滑性和轨迹级稳定性提出了严格要求，凸显了现有系统的局限。具体而言，流体仿真对于在线强化学习而言成本过高；人类遥操作在模仿学习过程中会引入非预期加速度，从而诱发液体晃动；此外，现有策略流程以任务完成为优化目标，而忽视了动态稳定性。为此，我们提出了一种虚实结合框架，将经过物理验证的数据生成与层级化的、基于扩散的控制器相结合。可扩展的数据流水线可合成抓取姿态，通过视觉-语言模型过滤不稳定的姿态，并借助流体仿真验证运输轨迹。该策略由高层模块和潜在扩散控制器组成，前者将语言和视觉观测转化为SE(3)控制目标，后者先在紧凑的潜在空间中进行高效规划，再解码出稠密的动作序列，从而实现平滑稳定运动所需的高控制频率。大量实验表明，我们的系统在运输平滑性和动态稳定性方面优于最先进的操作策略。项目主页：https://fetch-my-beer.github.io/
tldr: This paper proposes a synthetic-to-real hierarchical diffusion-based policy for stable pick-and-place of liquid-filled containers, using fluid simulation and vision-language models for data generation and trajectory planning. It demonstrates improved smoothness and dynamic stability over existing manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种合成到真实的层次化扩散策略，用于液体容器的稳定抓取和放置，通过流体模拟和视觉语言模型进行数据生成和轨迹规划，相比现有操纵策略在平滑性和动态稳定性上更优。

title: OpenDexGrasp: Open-vocabulary Task-Oriented Dexterous Grasping
summary: Dexterous grasp synthesis has advanced rapidly in generating stable and physically plausible hand poses, but real-world manipulation requires grasps that preserve the function implied by the task. We study open-vocabulary task-oriented dexterous grasp generation, where a robot must infer functional intent from free-form language, ground it in multi-view visual observations and object geometry, and generate an executable high-degree-of-freedom grasp. We present OpenDexGrasp, a unified data and generative modeling framework for this setting. OpenDexVerse provides dual-source supervision organized by the Coverage-to-Alignment (C2A) Recipe: OpenDex-Scale offers large-scale semantic and geometric coverage through automatic grasp synthesis and vision-language annotation, while OpenDex-Align supplies high-quality embodied alignment through human teleoperation and category-level transfer. OpenDexGrasp learns a shared perception-action latent representation that couples open-vocabulary vision-language context with dexterous action generation. Affordance grounding and grasp generation provide complementary supervision over this latent space, enabling direct generation of task-consistent dexterous grasps without a separate affordance-to-pose inference stage. Extensive simulation and real-robot experiments demonstrate improved functional alignment, physical feasibility, generalization to unseen categories, and real-world execution success. Additional details and videos are available at https://opendexgrasp.github.io/.
summary_zh: 灵巧抓取合成在生成稳定且物理上合理的手部姿态方面取得了快速进展，但现实世界中的操作任务要求抓取能够保持任务所蕴含的功能意图。我们研究了开放词汇的任务导向灵巧抓取生成问题，在该问题中，机器人需要从自由形式语言中推断功能意图，将其与多视角视觉观察和物体几何结构相关联，并生成可执行的高自由度抓取。我们提出了OpenDexGrasp，一个针对该场景的统一数据与生成建模框架。OpenDexVerse通过“覆盖到对齐”（C2A）策略提供双源监督：OpenDex-Scale通过自动抓取合成和视觉-语言标注提供大规模语义与几何覆盖，而OpenDex-Align则通过人类遥操作和类别级迁移提供高质量的具身对齐。OpenDexGrasp学习了一种共享的感知-动作潜在表示，将开放词汇的视觉-语言上下文与灵巧动作生成耦合起来。功能可供性定位与抓取生成在该潜在空间上提供互补监督，从而无需单独的“可供性到姿态”推理阶段即可直接生成与任务一致的灵巧抓取。大量仿真和真实机器人实验表明，该方法在功能对齐、物理可行性、对未见类别的泛化能力以及真实世界执行成功率方面均有所提升。更多细节和视频请参见https://opendexgrasp.github.io/。
tldr: OpenDexGrasp introduces a unified data and generative modeling framework for open-vocabulary task-oriented dexterous grasping, combining large-scale synthetic data with real teleoperation demonstrations and a shared perception-action latent space to directly generate task-consistent dexterous grasps from language and vision, validated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: OpenDexGrasp 提出了一个统一的框架，用于开放词汇的任务导向灵巧抓取，结合大规模合成数据和真实遥操作演示，通过共享感知-动作潜在空间直接从语言和视觉生成任务一致的抓取姿态，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。

title: A Comprehensive Review of Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence
summary: The integration of large-scale foundation models with physical embodiments has led to significant advancements in robotics known as Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence (GPAI). These agentic AI systems autonomously perceive, reason, and act in complex real-world situations. This survey comprehensively analyzes GPAI systems, focusing on their architectural foundations, current applications, and key limitations. We introduce a taxonomy of five distinct approaches: Robot Foundation Models (RFMs) for cross-platform skill transfer; Vision-Language Action (VLA) models for end-to-end multi-modal perception and control; Large Behavior Models (LBMs) for human-like movement generation; Diffusion Policy Models (DPMs) for diffusion model-based temporally coherent action generation; and World Foundation Models (WFMs) for physics-compliant simulation and data generation. We examine how these approaches complement each other: WFMs generate training data for VLAs and DPMs, RFMs enable cross-platform deployment of learned policies, while LBMs provide motion priors for natural behavior. Through examples across autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, healthcare robotics, and humanoid systems, we identify significant performance improvements and summarize promising research directions in data-efficient learning, sim-to-real transfer, edge-compatible architectures, and safety frameworks. These insights advance embodied AI for IoT-connected environments where intelligent agents interact with networked sensors, actuators, and edge devices.
summary_zh: 大型基础模型与物理实体的融合推动了机器人领域的重大进展，催生了被称为“生成式物理人工智能”（GPAI）的新兴方向。这类智能体系统能够在复杂真实环境中自主感知、推理并采取行动。本综述对GPAI系统进行了全面分析，重点聚焦其架构基础、当前应用及关键局限性。我们提出了一种包含五种不同方法的分类体系：用于跨平台技能迁移的机器人基础模型（RFMs）；用于端到端多模态感知与控制的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）；用于类人动作生成的大型行为模型（LBMs）；基于扩散模型的时间连贯动作生成的扩散策略模型（DPMs）；以及用于符合物理规律的仿真与数据生成的世界基础模型（WFMs）。我们考察了这些方法之间的互补关系：WFMs为VLAs和DPMs生成训练数据，RFMs实现所学策略的跨平台部署，而LBMs为自然行为提供运动先验。通过自动驾驶、工业自动化、医疗机器人和人形系统等领域的实例，我们识别出了显著的性能提升，并总结了数据高效学习、仿真到现实迁移、边缘兼容架构及安全框架等具有前景的研究方向。这些见解推动了面向物联网互联环境的具身智能发展，在该环境中智能体与网络化传感器、执行器和边缘设备进行交互。
tldr: This survey comprehensively reviews Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence (GPAI), proposing a taxonomy of five approaches (RFMs, VLAs, LBMs, DPMs, WFMs) and discussing their synergies, applications, and research directions for embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 本综述全面回顾了生成式物理人工智能（GPAI），提出了五种方法（RFMs、VLAs、LBMs、DPMs、WFMs）的分类法，并讨论了它们的协同作用、应用和研究方向。

title: Causal-History Test-Time Scaling for Failure Recovery in Autoregressive World-Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation by jointly modeling future visual dynamics and robot actions. However, existing WAMs are trained predominantly on successful trajectories, making them prone to failure when real-world execution diverges from the learned dynamics. This issue is amplified in autoregressive WAMs, where execution errors become part of the causal history and continue to influence subsequent predictions. To this end, we introduce \method{}, a training-free framework that reformulates failure recovery as \emph{test-time scaling over causal histories}. This formulation decomposes recovery into three coupled decisions: \emph{when} to revise the causal history, \emph{where} to recover a reliable history prefix, and \emph{which} history configuration best supports subsequent execution. Specifically, \method{} realizes these decisions through three stages: 1) \textbf{Progress-Aware Recovery Trigger} detects persistent non-progress and triggers recovery only when the current execution state permits intervention; 2) \textbf{History-Prefix Recovery} identifies the unreliable history suffix, retrieves a historical anchor matching the current physical state, and reconstructs the causal KV state from the retained prefix while conditioning on the latest real observation; and 3) \textbf{Hypothesis Verification} compares the future continuations induced by complete-history, recovered-prefix, and full-reset hypotheses, and commits the best-supported hypothesis. Experiments in both simulated and real-world manipulation settings demonstrate consistent improvements in task success, while ablations confirm the contribution of each recovery stage.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）已成为机器人操作领域一种颇具前景的范式，通过联合建模未来视觉动态与机器人动作来实现操作任务。然而，现有的WAMs主要基于成功轨迹进行训练，当真实世界执行偏离所学动态时，其表现容易失效。这一问题在自回归WAMs中被进一步放大，因为执行误差会进入因果历史并持续影响后续预测。为此，我们提出\method{}，一种无需训练的框架，将失败恢复重新表述为\emph{因果历史上的测试时扩展}。该表述将恢复过程分解为三个耦合决策：\emph{何时}修正因果历史、\emph{何处}恢复可靠的历史前缀，以及\emph{哪个}历史配置最能支持后续执行。具体而言，\method{}通过三个阶段实现上述决策：1）\textbf{进度感知恢复触发}检测持续无进展状态，并仅在当前执行状态允许干预时触发恢复；2）\textbf{历史前缀恢复}识别不可靠的历史后缀，检索与当前物理状态匹配的历史锚点，并在保留前缀的基础上以最新真实观测为条件重建因果KV状态；以及3）\textbf{假设验证}比较由完整历史、恢复前缀和完全重置三种假设所引导的未来延续，并采纳证据最充分的假设。在仿真和真实世界操作环境中的实验均表明，任务成功率得到一致提升，消融实验进一步确认了各恢复阶段的贡献。
tldr: This paper introduces a training-free framework that improves failure recovery in autoregressive world-action models for robot manipulation by reformulating recovery as test-time scaling over causal histories, with three stages: progress-aware triggering, history-prefix recovery, and hypothesis verification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需训练的框架，通过将失败恢复重构为因果历史上的测试时扩展，改善自回归世界动作模型在机器人操作中的失败恢复能力，包括三个步骤：进度感知触发、历史前缀恢复和假设验证。

title: Learning Multi-Humanoid Pickup and Transport via Decentralized Object-Centric Control
summary: We study cooperative multi-humanoid pickup and transport of objects with varying size, weight, and geometry, requiring robot teams of different sizes. Our approach uses decentralized object-centric control, where each humanoid is assigned a local attachment region on the shared object and learns to realize pickup and transport through gripperless bimanual pinching. This attachment-based interface provides a common control abstraction spanning single-robot pickup, cooperative multi-robot transport, and robot-to-robot handover, without per-task redesign. We find that policies trained only on single-robot pickup already transfer nontrivially to cooperative settings, suggesting that this abstraction captures much of the structure needed for coordination. At the same time, explicit multi-robot training further improves performance, showing that shared-object coupling introduces coordination dynamics that are beneficial to learn directly. We validate the approach in simulation across varying team sizes and object geometries, and demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on hardware, where the learned controllers enable real humanoids to perform cooperative manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 我们研究合作式多仿人机器人拾取与搬运不同尺寸、重量和几何形状物体的任务，该任务需要不同规模的机器人团队。我们的方法采用去中心化的物体中心控制，其中每个仿人机器人在共享物体上被分配一个局部附着区域，并通过无夹爪的双臂捏合动作学习实现拾取与搬运。这种基于附着区域的接口提供了一种通用控制抽象，涵盖单机器人拾取、多机器人协同搬运以及机器人之间的交接，而无需针对每项任务重新设计。我们发现，仅在单机器人拾取任务上训练的策略已经能够显著迁移到合作场景中，这表明该抽象捕捉到了协调所需的大部分结构信息。同时，显式的多机器人训练进一步提升了性能，表明共享物体的耦合引入的协调动态值得直接学习。我们在仿真中验证了该方法在不同团队规模和物体几何形状下的有效性，并在硬件上展示了仿真到现实的迁移，其中学习到的控制器使真实仿人机器人能够执行合作操作任务。
tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized, object-centric control framework for multi-humanoid cooperative pickup and transport, validated in simulation and on real hardware, showing that single-robot training transfers to multi-robot settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种去中心化的、以物体为中心的控制框架，用于多人形机器人协作拾取和搬运，并在仿真和真实硬件上验证了单机器人训练可迁移到多机器人场景。

title: RAF-VLA: Representation Alignment with the Future for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving have incorporated world modeling by predicting future driving scenes alongside driving actions, demonstrating strong planning performance. Future driving scenes are utilized as dense supervision, encouraging the policy to learn rich internal representations useful for planning. However, these World-Modeling VLAs rely on explicit future generation to learn such representations, thereby introducing two key limitations: additional training burden and inference latency. To address these limitations, we propose RAF-VLA (Representation Alignment with the Future), a VLA-based autonomous driving framework that shapes planning-relevant internal representations through direct guidance from future-frame representations. RAF-VLA employs Future-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning, in which a straightforward regularization aligns the policy's hidden states with future-frame representations obtained from a pretrained world encoder while learning driving actions. This simple alignment allows RAF-VLA to avoid the training burden and inference latency associated with future generation. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark show that RAF-VLA achieves competitive planning performance against state-of-the-art VLA planners with substantially fewer training samples seen. Moreover, RAF-VLA incurs only 3.8% training overhead and a negligible 1 ms inference overhead.
summary_zh: 近期面向自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过预测未来驾驶场景及驾驶动作，融入了世界建模能力，展现出强大的规划性能。未来驾驶场景被用作密集监督信号，促使策略学习对规划有用的丰富内部表征。然而，这类“世界建模VLA”依赖显式的未来生成来学习此类表征，从而引入了两个关键限制：额外的训练负担和推理延迟。为解决这些问题，我们提出RAF-VLA（面向未来的表征对齐），一种基于VLA的自动驾驶框架，通过未来帧表征的直接引导来塑造与规划相关的内部表征。RAF-VLA采用未来对齐的有监督微调方法，在学习驾驶动作的同时，通过一种简洁的正则化机制将策略的隐藏状态与预训练世界编码器获得的未来帧表征对齐。这种简单的对齐方式使RAF-VLA能够避免未来生成所带来的训练负担和推理延迟。在NAVSIM基准上的大量实验表明，RAF-VLA在显著减少训练样本的情况下，实现了与最先进的VLA规划器相当的规划性能。此外，RAF-VLA仅增加3.8%的训练开销和可忽略不计的1毫秒推理开销。
tldr: RAF-VLA proposes a VLA-based autonomous driving framework that aligns policy hidden states with future-frame representations from a pretrained world encoder, avoiding the training and inference costs of explicit future generation while achieving competitive planning performance on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: RAF-VLA 提出了一种基于VLA的自动驾驶框架，通过将策略隐状态与预训练世界编码器的未来帧表示对齐，避免了显式未来生成的训练和推理成本，同时在NAVSIM上取得了有竞争力的规划性能。

title: Vision-Language Grounded Task-Context-Aware Imitation Learning for Robotic Disassembly
summary: Real-world robotic disassembly requires long-horizon execution, where robots must perform ordered sequences of manipulation tasks across multiple parts within a single scene. Multiple valid task goals and diverse assembly configurations make it difficult for imitation policies to infer the intended skill from raw observations alone, particularly when training data cannot cover the combinatorial diversity of real-world configurations and part geometries. We show that incorporating task context through language alleviates these challenges by providing explicit structure for skill selection and associating language-specified tasks with their corresponding manipulation targets in the visual scene. The proposed framework combines hierarchical task selection with task-context-aware imitation learning to ground language instructions in spatial visual representations for robotic disassembly. The resulting framework generalizes across diverse connector geometries and assembly configurations without requiring explicit object annotations. Our method improves end-to-end task success by 35 percentage points over the baseline diffusion policy and by 75 percentage points over the previous task-context-aware baseline.
summary_zh: 真实世界中的机器人拆解任务需要长时间的执行跨度，机器人必须在单一场景中对多个部件执行有序的操作序列。由于存在多个有效的任务目标以及多样的装配配置，模仿策略难以仅凭原始观测推断出预期技能，尤其是在训练数据无法覆盖现实世界配置与部件几何形态组合多样性的情况下。我们证明，通过语言引入任务上下文能够缓解这些挑战，因为它为技能选择提供了明确的结构，并将语言指定的任务与视觉场景中对应的操作目标关联起来。所提出的框架将层次化任务选择与任务上下文感知的模仿学习相结合，将语言指令锚定在空间视觉表征中，以支持机器人拆解任务。该框架无需显式对象标注，即可在不同连接件几何形态和装配配置之间实现泛化。与基准扩散策略相比，我们的方法将端到端任务成功率提升了35个百分点，与此前任务上下文感知基线相比提升了75个百分点。
tldr: This paper introduces a hierarchical task-context-aware imitation learning framework that uses language instructions to ground visual representations for robotic disassembly, improving end-to-end task success significantly over baseline policies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种层级任务上下文感知的模仿学习框架，利用语言指令在视觉表征中进行接地，用于机器人拆解任务，相比于基线策略显著提升了端到端任务成功率。

title: CSWAM: Better Causal Semantic Representations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in World Action Models
summary: FastWAM-style world action models enable efficient action-only inference, but generalize poorly under visual distribution shifts. Their reconstruction-oriented representations emphasize appearance-specific details, limiting generalization to unseen scenes and objects. Without observation history, the model also lacks temporal evidence for robustly identifying task-relevant state changes and motion in unfamiliar visual conditions. To address these limitations, we present the Causal Semantic World Action Model (CSWAM), which augments FastWAM with a causal semantic expert built on V-JEPA 2.1. V-JEPA provides temporally grounded representations of semantic state changes and motion with less dependence on appearance-specific details. The expert learns their future evolution from a sparse history of current and past observations and shares the history-derived context with both the video and action streams through causal attention. At inference, CSWAM conditions action denoising on the current video state and observed semantic history, retaining efficient action-only inference. We conduct simulation and real-robot experiments to evaluate generalization under distribution shifts. With embodied pretraining, CSWAM raises Randomized success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized transfer from 10.16% to 45.18%, a gain of 35.02 percentage points over FastWAM. Across two real-robot tasks and three OOD difficulty levels, CSWAM improves average success over FastWAM by 42.5 percentage points, from 27.5% to 70.0%.
summary_zh: FastWAM风格的世界动作模型能够实现高效的动作推断，但在视觉分布偏移下泛化能力较差。其面向重建的表征过度关注外观特有细节，限制了对未见场景和物体的泛化能力。由于缺乏观测历史，模型也缺少时间维度的证据，难以在陌生视觉条件下稳健地识别任务相关的状态变化和运动。为解决上述局限性，我们提出了因果语义世界动作模型（CSWAM），该模型在FastWAM的基础上引入了基于V-JEPA 2.1构建的因果语义专家模块。V-JEPA能够提供语义状态变化和运动的时间维度表征，且对外观特有细节的依赖度较低。该专家模块从当前和过去的稀疏观测历史中学习语义状态未来演化，并通过因果注意力机制将基于历史提取的上下文信息同时传递给视频流和动作流。在推理阶段，CSWAM以当前视频状态和观测到的语义历史为条件对动作去噪过程进行约束，同时保持高效的动作仅推断模式。我们开展了仿真和真实机器人实验，评估分布偏移下的泛化性能。通过具身预训练，CSWAM在RoboTwin 2.0从清洁域到随机域的迁移任务中将Randomized成功率从10.16%提升至45.18%，相较FastWAM提升了35.02个百分点。在两项真实机器人任务和三个OOD难度等级上，CSWAM将平均成功率从27.5%提升至70.0%，较FastWAM提高了42.5个百分点。
tldr: CSWAM augments FastWAM-style world action models with a causal semantic expert built on V-JEPA 2.1 to improve out-of-distribution generalization in robot manipulation, achieving significant success-rate gains in simulation and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: CSWAM利用基于V-JEPA 2.1的因果语义专家增强FastWAM风格的世界动作模型，以提升机器人操作在分布偏移下的泛化能力，在仿真和真实机器人任务中显著提高了成功率。

title: StrucPhysVideo: Learning Physical Dynamics from Structured Captions and Robot Actions
summary: Modeling physical dynamics, including how objects move, interact, and change state, is central to video world models for embodied AI. We present StrucPhysVideo, a family of video world models that bridges physics-focused data curation with language- and action-conditioned prediction of scene evolution. Our data pipeline combines motion-aware video segmentation, quality and content filtering, and physical relevance verification with structured annotations of objects, materials, and temporally localized interactions. By disentangling camera motion from object behavior and explicitly describing contact, deformation, and state transitions, the pipeline provides supervision grounded in observable physical events. Building on these data, we introduce StrucPhysVideo-TI2V, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) text-image-to-video model trained with a curriculum that progressively emphasizes physical dynamics while retaining general-domain video data. StrucPhysVideo-TI2V achieves state-of-the-art performance on Physics-IQ Verified, scoring 45.5% and outperforming Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video by 2.8 percentage points. Caption ablations across backbones further demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-focused supervision. We further extend StrucPhysVideo-TI2V to StrucPhysVideo-IA2V, an interactive image-action-to-video world model that predicts visual outcomes from robot end-effector commands. Action conditioning, causal autoregressive generation, and few-step distillation enable incremental robot rollouts with only four denoising steps. Together, StrucPhysVideo advances physical dynamics modeling from image- and language-conditioned video prediction toward action-driven interaction.
summary_zh: 建模物理动力学（包括物体如何移动、交互及改变状态）是具身智能视频世界模型的核心。我们提出了StrucPhysVideo，一个视频世界模型系列，将聚焦物理的数据构建与语言及动作条件下的场景演化预测相结合。我们的数据流程整合了运动感知视频分割、质量与内容过滤、物理相关性验证，以及针对物体、材质和时域局部交互的结构化标注。通过将相机运动与物体行为分离，并显式描述接触、形变和状态转换，该流程提供了基于可观测物理事件的监督信号。基于这些数据，我们提出了StrucPhysVideo-TI2V，一种稀疏专家混合（MoE）文本-图像到视频模型，采用逐步强调物理动力学的课程学习策略进行训练，同时保留通用域视频数据。StrucPhysVideo-TI2V在Physics-IQ Verified基准上取得了最先进性能，得分为45.5%，比Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video高出2.8个百分点。跨骨干网络的描述消融实验进一步验证了聚焦物理监督的有效性。我们进一步将StrucPhysVideo-TI2V扩展为StrucPhysVideo-IA2V，一种交互式图像-动作到视频的世界模型，能够从机器人末端执行器指令预测视觉结果。动作条件、因果自回归生成以及少步蒸馏使得仅需四步去噪即可实现增量式机器人推演。总体而言，StrucPhysVideo将物理动力学建模从图像和语言条件下的视频预测推进至动作驱动的交互。
tldr: StrucPhysVideo introduces a physics-focused data curation pipeline and a sparse MoE video world model, StrucPhysVideo-TI2V, that achieves state-of-the-art performance on Physics-IQ Verified, and extends it to an interactive image-action-to-video world model (IA2V) for robot action-conditioned rollouts.
tldr_zh: StrucPhysVideo 提出了一种以物理为中心的数据整理流程和稀疏 MoE 视频世界模型 StrucPhysVideo-TI2V，在 Physics-IQ Verified 上取得了最先进性能，并将其扩展到交互式图像-动作到视频世界模型 (IA2V)，用于机器人动作条件下的 rollout。

title: Finder: Agentic Closed-Loop Object Finding for Embodied Grounding
summary: Finding the object referred to by language in a partially observed 3D scene is a core capability for embodied agents. Existing approaches either couple object search with online exploration, which can be costly when relevant observations have already been captured, or query pre-built open-vocabulary maps and scene graphs in a static, one-shot fashion. We present Finder, an agentic closed-loop object-finding primitive for embodied grounding. Instead of treating grounding as passive retrieval from a fixed scene representation, Finder maintains a typed loop state that links query-conditioned planning, scoped evidence gathering, candidate verification, and accept/continue/abort control. When evidence is incomplete or ambiguous, the loop can redirect subsequent perception and comparison rather than simply returning the top retrieved object. On open-vocabulary embodied Object Retrieval in Habitat/HM3D and real-world RGB-D scenes, Finder improves the averaged 1m success rate by 15.75 points over strong baselines. The same primitive also transfers to sequential object grounding and embodied object-centric question answering, improving spatial and temporal localization without changing the inner grounding protocol. Project page: https://finder-vln.github.io.
summary_zh: 在部分可观测的三维场景中，定位语言所指对象是具身智能体的核心能力之一。现有方法要么将对象搜索与在线探索耦合在一起，在相关观测已被捕获时可能导致高昂代价；要么以静态、单次查询的方式访问预构建的开放词汇地图和场景图。我们提出Finder，一种用于具身接地（embodied grounding）的智能闭环对象查找原语。Finder并未将接地视为从固定场景表示中的被动检索，而是维护一个类型化的循环状态，将查询条件化规划、范围化证据收集、候选验证以及接受/继续/中止控制相连接。当证据不完整或存在歧义时，该循环能够重新引导后续感知与比较，而不仅仅是返回检索到的排名最高的对象。在Habitat/HM3D和真实世界RGB-D场景中的开放词汇具身对象检索任务上，Finder相较于强基线方法在平均1米成功率上提升了15.75个百分点。该原语同样可迁移至顺序对象接地和具身对象中心问答任务，在不改变内部接地协议的情况下提升了空间与时间定位能力。项目页面：https://finder-vln.github.io。
tldr: Finder presents an agentic closed-loop object-finding primitive that iteratively plans, gathers evidence, and verifies candidates to improve embodied language grounding in 3D scenes, achieving significant success-rate gains over static retrieval baselines in Habitat and real-world tests.
tldr_zh: Finder提出了一种智能体闭环目标寻找基元，通过迭代规划、收集证据和验证候选来改进3D场景中的具身语言接地，在Habitat和真实世界测试中显著提升了成功率。

title: ElastiQP: An Always-Feasible QP Solver for Constrained Robot Control
summary: As robot capabilities increase, quadratic programming (QP)-based controllers must account for a similarly increasing number of constraints to ensure safe, reliable operation. Yet, with each added constraint, this introduces more chances of momentary conflict: in which case, a QP solver that returns an "infeasible" status leaves the controller with nothing to execute. To address this, we introduce ElastiQP, a modified dual active-set QP solver that relaxes every inequality constraint with an exact, per-constraint l1 penalty while keeping equality constraints (dynamics) hard. Notably, ElastiQP does so by folding the slack variables into the solver analytically, maintaining a constant size of the condensed linear system. On a suite of robot control benchmarks, ElastiQP achieves microsecond-level performance, matching or outperforming leading modern solvers on feasible problems. On infeasible problems, ElastiQP handles these gracefully, confining violations to strictly the conflicting inequality terms, returning a usable solution up to 40x faster than the best alternative solvers. ElastiQP is available as an open-source C++ header-only library, with Python and JAX interfaces, at https://github.com/StanfordASL/elastiqp.
summary_zh: 随着机器人能力的提升，基于二次规划（QP）的控制器必须考虑数量同样增加的约束条件，以确保安全、可靠的操作。然而，每增加一个约束，就会带来更多瞬时冲突的可能：在这种情况下，若QP求解器返回“不可行”状态，控制器将无指令可执行。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ElastiQP——一种改进的对偶有效集QP求解器，它对每个不等式约束施加精确的逐约束l1惩罚项进行松弛，同时保持等式约束（动力学）为硬约束。值得注意的是，ElastiQP通过解析方式将松弛变量折叠进求解器中，从而保持紧缩线性系统规模恒定。在一系列机器人控制基准测试中，ElastiQP实现了微秒级性能，在可行问题上与领先的现代求解器持平或更优。对于不可行问题，ElastiQP能够优雅地处理，将违约严格限制在冲突的不等式约束项上，并比最佳替代求解器快至多40倍地返回可用解。ElastiQP已作为开源C++头文件库发布，并支持Python及JAX接口，代码见 https://github.com/StanfordASL/elastiqp。
tldr: ElastiQP introduces a modified dual active-set QP solver that relaxes inequality constraints with exact l1 penalties, ensuring always-feasible solutions for robot control while maintaining microsecond-level performance and matching or outperforming modern solvers on feasible problems.
tldr_zh: ElastiQP 提出了一种改进的对偶积极集 QP 求解器，通过精确的 l1 惩罚松弛不等式约束，确保机器人控制始终有可行解，同时保持微秒级性能。

title: CaSCo: Cascade-Aware Soft-Collision Motion Planning
summary: Conventional motion planning treats collision as a binary constraint, although contact with different objects can have drastically different consequences. A robot may safely brush against a cardboard box while even minor contact with a glass, laptop, or unstable object may be undesirable. Moreover, a direct robot--object collision can move the contacted object and trigger secondary object--object collisions, making the risk of a motion depend on the physical evolution of the scene rather than only on the robot's geometric path. We present CaSCo, a cascade-aware soft-collision motion planning framework in which a vision-language or language model assigns semantic risk to objects and a physics simulator predicts the consequences of candidate robot motions. CaSCo searches for a path that minimizes the total semantic risk of the unique objects displaced either directly by the robot or indirectly through cascaded collisions. Because collisions change the environment, we augment roadmap states with the predicted object arrangement and the set of objects whose risk has already been incurred. We develop an optimal graph-search algorithm with an admissible and consistent cascade-relaxed heuristic and caching and pruning mechanisms for efficient search. Experiments in cluttered manipulation environments evaluate semantic risk, cascade reasoning, planning efficiency, and real-robot operation.
summary_zh: 传统运动规划将碰撞视为二元约束，然而与不同物体的接触可能带来截然不同的后果。机器人或许可以安全地擦碰纸箱，但即便与玻璃杯、笔记本电脑或不稳定物体的轻微接触也可能是不被期望的。此外，机器人直接与物体碰撞不仅会移动被接触的物体，还可能引发物体间的二次碰撞，这使得运动的风险取决于场景的物理演变，而非仅取决于机器人的几何路径。我们提出了CaSCo，一个级联感知的软碰撞运动规划框架，其中视觉-语言模型或语言模型为物体赋予语义风险，物理模拟器则预测候选机器人运动的后果。CaSCo搜索一条路径，以最小化由机器人直接或通过级联碰撞间接移动的独特物体的总语义风险。由于碰撞会改变环境，我们在地图状态中增强了预测的物体排列以及已产生风险的物体集合。我们开发了一种最优图搜索算法，采用可采纳且一致的级联松弛启发式函数，并配备缓存和剪枝机制以实现高效搜索。在杂乱的操作环境中进行的实验评估了语义风险、级联推理、规划效率以及真实机器人操作。
tldr: CaSCo is a motion planning framework that uses semantic risk labels from VLM/LLM and physics simulation to plan paths minimizing cascaded collision risk in cluttered manipulation environments.
tldr_zh: CaSCo 是一个运动规划框架，利用视觉语言模型/语言模型的语义风险标签和物理模拟来规划路径，以最小化杂乱操作环境中的级联碰撞风险。

title: Towards Interaction Regulation from Human Feedback via Free Energy Minimization
summary: A central challenge across control and learning is the design of mechanisms regulating the interactions between humans and autonomous agents. Inspired by the free energy principle from computational neuroscience, we introduce a control-theoretical framework to integrate human preferences online into an agent policy. We turn the framework into an open control architecture and validate our approach using a human-in-the-loop experimental testbed involving a rover navigating via onboard sensing. The human, remotely located and equipped with virtual reality headsets, shares the same sensory information as the rover. Human preferences are provided to the rover via gestures which introduce both cooperative and competitive interactions between the agent goal and the preferences. The experiments show that interactions are regulated, validating the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 控制与学习领域的一个核心挑战，在于设计能够调节人类与自主智能体之间交互的机制。受计算神经科学中自由能原理的启发，我们引入了一个控制理论框架，旨在将人类偏好在线整合至智能体的策略中。我们将该框架转化为一种开放式的控制架构，并通过一个涉及人类参与的在环实验测试平台来验证我们的方法，该平台包括一辆通过车载传感进行导航的漫游车。人类操作者远程接入，配备虚拟现实头显，与漫游车共享相同的感官信息。人类偏好通过手势传达给漫游车，由此在智能体目标与偏好之间引入了合作与竞争的双重互动。实验结果表明，这些互动得到了有效调控，从而验证了所提出的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a control-theoretic framework based on the free energy principle to integrate human preference feedback online into an agent policy, validated with a human-in-the-loop rover navigation testbed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于自由能原理的控制理论框架，将人类偏好在线整合到智能体策略中，并通过人机协同的漫游车导航实验平台进行验证。

title: Asymptotically Optimal Multi-Robot Task and Motion Planning
summary: Multi-robot task and motion planning (MR-TAMP) requires jointly reasoning about discrete task decisions and continuous collision-free motions of multiple interacting robots. Although asymptotically optimal algorithms have been developed for task and motion planning, extending these guarantees to the multi-robot setting introduces an important challenge: different task transitions may involve different subsets of robots and therefore impose constraints of different dimensions on the composite configuration space. Consequently, an asymptotically optimal planner must not only optimize motion within each task mode, but also ensure sufficient exploration of the different types of transitions connecting them. We characterize this transition structure and establish sufficient conditions for global asymptotic optimality in MR-TAMP, requiring persistent coverage of relevant transitions and asymptotically improving motion planning within connected feasible regions. Based on these conditions, we develop an efficient asymptotically optimal MR-TAMP algorithm that combines evolving individual-robot roadmaps with implicit tensor-product search, avoiding explicit construction of the composite roadmap. The planner further employs conditional transition sampling, lazy collision checking, and mode- and solution-level guidance to improve finite-time planning efficiency while retaining persistent exploration. The resulting framework provides asymptotic optimality guarantees for multi-robot manipulation while efficiently exploiting the structure of individual-robot motion planning.
summary_zh: 多机器人任务与运动规划（MR-TAMP）要求对多个交互机器人的离散任务决策及其连续无碰撞运动进行联合推理。尽管已有针对任务与运动规划的渐近最优算法，但将这些保证推广到多机器人场景中会引入一个关键挑战：不同的任务转换可能涉及不同的机器人子集，从而对复合构型空间施加不同维度的约束。因此，一个渐近最优的规划器不仅需要在每个任务模式内优化运动，还必须确保对连接这些模式的不同类型转换进行充分探索。我们刻画了这种转换结构，并建立了MR-TAMP中全局渐近最优性的充分条件，要求对相关转换进行持续覆盖，并在连通可行区域内实现渐近改进的运动规划。基于这些条件，我们提出了一种高效的渐近最优MR-TAMP算法，该算法将不断演化的单机器人道路图与隐式张量积搜索相结合，避免了显式构建复合道路图。该规划器进一步采用条件转换采样、惰性碰撞检测以及模式级和解级引导，以在保持持续探索的同时提升有限时间内的规划效率。由此形成的框架为多机器人操作提供了渐近最优性保证，同时有效利用了单机器人运动规划的结构特性。
tldr: The paper develops an asymptotically optimal planner for multi-robot task and motion planning, addressing the challenge of transitions involving different robot subsets with persistent exploration and implicit tensor-product search.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种渐近最优的多机器人任务与运动规划算法，通过持续探索相关转换和隐式张量积搜索来处理不同机器人子集间的转换约束。

title: TRACER: Adaptive Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Joint Human-Response Prediction and Interaction-Aware Replanning
summary: Multi-robot navigation in human-shared spaces is inherently interactive: coordinated robot motions influence how nearby entities respond, while those responses provide valuable information for subsequent robot decisions. However, existing methods typically address action-conditioned prediction, multi-robot planning, or online adaptation separately, and therefore lack a unified mechanism for modeling joint robot-entity interactions and adapting future decisions from executed interaction outcomes. To address this gap, we propose TRACER, a bi-directional receding-horizon framework that closes the loop between prediction and adaptation. TRACER evaluates candidate (i.e., alternative feasible future motion plans for the robot team) trajectories using a per-entity probabilistic response model that separates individual-robot effects from non-additive pairwise interactions; after executing the selected trajectory prefix, it updates persistent identity-bound beliefs over latent response modes using the synchronized observed responses. These updated beliefs then guide subsequent candidate evaluation under probabilistic safety and response-aware cost criteria. Experiments show that (i) TRACER more accurately captures non-additive multi-robot interaction effects than a capacity-matched additive predictor, (ii) persistent identity-consistent evidence improves response prediction and downstream replanning, and (iii) the complete TRACER framework improves collision-free completion over an independent-robot baseline on the SocialGym2 multi-robot social-navigation benchmark.
summary_zh: 在人类共享空间中，多机器人导航本质上是交互式的：协调的机器人运动会影响附近实体的反应，而这些反应又为后续的机器人决策提供了宝贵信息。然而，现有方法通常分别处理动作条件预测、多机器人规划或在线自适应，因此缺乏统一机制来建模机器人-实体间的联合交互，并根据已执行的交互结果调整未来决策。为填补这一空白，我们提出TRACER，一种双向滚动时域框架，闭环连接预测与自适应。TRACER利用逐实体概率响应模型来评估候选（即机器人团队可行的替代未来运动计划）轨迹，该模型将单个机器人效应与非可加的两两交互分离；在执行所选的轨迹前缀后，根据同步观测到的响应，更新持续存在的身份绑定潜在响应模式信念。这些更新后的信念随后在概率安全性和响应感知代价准则下引导后续候选评估。实验表明：(i) TRACER比容量匹配的可加性预测器更准确地捕捉多机器人非可加交互效应；(ii) 持续的身份一致证据能改善响应预测及下游重规划；(iii) 完整的TRACER框架在SocialGym2多机器人社交导航基准上，相比独立机器人基线提高了无碰撞完成率。
tldr: TRACER introduces a bi-directional receding-horizon framework for multi-robot social navigation that jointly models human-robot interactions via a probabilistic response model, uses persistent identity-bound beliefs to update predictions from executed outcomes, and demonstrates improved collision-free completion on the SocialGym2 benchmark.
tldr_zh: TRACER 提出了一种用于多机器人社交导航的双向滚动时域框架，通过概率响应模型联合建模人与机器人的交互，利用持续的身份绑定信念从已执行结果中更新预测，并在 SocialGym2 基准上展示了改进的无碰撞完成率。

title: DeformSmith: Physics Harness-Guided Hierarchical Generation of Deformable Assets for Robot Manipulation
summary: Creating deformable assets for robot manipulation requires jointly specifying their geometry, appearance, and physical properties. This is especially challenging for deformable objects, since text and images provide limited evidence about how they deform and respond to contact, yet these responses directly affect their suitability for interaction. Automated generation therefore needs to resolve coupled physical requirements and use interaction evidence to guide construction and refinement. We present DeformSmith, a framework that enables automated generation of interactive, physically credible deformable assets from text or a single image. Through hierarchical agentic construction and a shared physics-grounded harness, it progressively builds, tests, and refines geometry, physical models, material behavior, and robot interaction until the resulting asset is ready for simulation and manipulation. Robot interaction closes the generation loop through manipulation feedback and replayable interaction data. Results show that DeformSmith generates assets with better visual quality and physical plausibility than state-of-the-art baselines, including PhysGen3D, PhysGM, and PhysX-Omni, while supporting the synthesis of data for robotic manipulation of deformable objects. Project page: https://can-lee.github.io/deformsmith-web/
summary_zh: 为机器人操作创建可变形资产，需要同时确定其几何形状、外观和物理属性。对于可变形物体而言，这一任务尤为具有挑战性，因为文本和图像对其变形方式及接触响应的证据支持十分有限，而这些响应直接影响其是否适合交互操作。因此，自动化生成需要解决耦合的物理需求，并利用交互证据来指导构建与优化。我们提出了DeformSmith框架，能够根据文本或单张图像自动生成可交互且物理可信的可变形资产。通过分层智能体式构建和共享的物理接地框架，它逐步构建、测试并优化几何模型、物理模型、材料行为及机器人交互，直至生成的资产可用于仿真和操作。机器人交互通过操作反馈和可回放的交互数据闭环生成流程。实验结果表明，DeformSmith生成的资产在视觉质量和物理合理性上优于最先进的基线方法（包括PhysGen3D、PhysGM和PhysX-Omni），同时支持可变形物体机器人操作数据的合成。项目主页：https://can-lee.github.io/deformsmith-web/
tldr: DeformSmith is a framework for automatically generating physically credible deformable assets from text or a single image, using hierarchical agentic construction and physics-grounded feedback to support robot manipulation simulation and data synthesis.
tldr_zh: DeformSmith是一个从文本或单张图像自动生成物理可信的可变形物体的框架，通过分层代理构建和基于物理的反馈来支持机器人操作模拟和数据合成。

title: 4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review
summary: Research on 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms has flourished in recent years, extending from signal processing and object detection to semantic segmentation, motion estimation, occupancy prediction, and dynamic scene reconstruction. This review organizes the field according to the evolution of perception tasks and algorithms. It first introduces radar fundamentals, data representations, and quality-enhancement methods, and then reviews object-level perception, motion and localization, local and dense spatial perception, and dynamic scene understanding. Across these directions, we compare radar-only learning, multimodal fusion, and cross-modal supervision and knowledge distillation. Particular attention is paid to how elevation, Doppler measurements, and radar physical priors are exploited across tasks. We further summarize the task coverage, input data, annotations, and evaluation protocols of existing datasets, clarifying the empirical support for different research directions. Finally, we discuss the common challenges and future directions of 4D radar perception for autonomous driving. This review provides a task-oriented perspective on the transition from sparse object perception to dynamic spatial understanding.
summary_zh: 四维毫米波雷达感知算法的研究近年来蓬勃发展，其研究范畴已从信号处理、目标检测扩展至语义分割、运动估计、占用预测以及动态场景重建等多个方面。本综述根据感知任务与算法的演进脉络，对该领域进行系统梳理。文章首先介绍雷达基本原理、数据表示及质量增强方法，继而依次评述目标级感知、运动与定位、局部及密集空间感知，以及动态场景理解等方向。在上述各方向中，我们对纯雷达学习、多模态融合、跨模态监督与知识蒸馏等方法进行了比较分析，并特别关注在不同任务中如何利用俯仰角信息、多普勒测量值以及雷达物理先验知识。进一步地，我们系统总结了现有数据集在任务覆盖范围、输入数据形式、标注方式及评测协议等方面的特点，明确了各研究方向所依赖的实验支撑。最后，我们探讨了四维雷达感知在自动驾驶应用中面临的共性挑战及未来发展趋势。本综述以任务为导向，呈现了从稀疏目标感知向动态空间理解演进的完整图景。
tldr: This paper is a comprehensive review of 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms for autonomous driving, covering tasks from object detection to dynamic scene reconstruction, and discussing data, methods, and future directions.
tldr_zh: 本文全面综述了用于自动驾驶的4D毫米波雷达感知算法，涵盖从目标检测到动态场景重建的任务，并讨论了数据、方法和未来方向。

title: InterMASH: A Unified Geometric Representation for Grasp Synthesis
summary: Grasp synthesis aims to generate stable and physically plausible hand--object interactions, and has become a fundamental problem in both human hand modeling and robotic manipulation. However, a unified representation across human and robotic hands is still lacking, mainly due to differences in hand morphology and surface modeling. Prior methods typically rely on either contact maps or dense implicit descriptors to represent interaction, but these representations are often incomplete or computationally expensive and redundant. We propose InterMASH, a unified geometric representation that establishes cross-embodiment correspondence using sphere-fixed anchors. At each anchor, low-degree spherical harmonics compactly encode local hand geometry, object geometry, and contact, forming an explicit and interpretable token sequence. Building on this natively tokenized structure, we introduce a conditional Diffusion Transformer that operates directly in the proposed InterMASH representation space and jointly generates hand geometry and contact, improving consistency and physical plausibility. Our method achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods on key physical feasibility metrics in a large-scale ShadowHand benchmark, supports joint training across multiple hands, and shows that cross-embodiment fine-tuning with human grasp data can improve robotic grasp success and diversity. Project page is available at https://inter-mash.github.io/.
summary_zh: 抓取合成旨在生成稳定且物理上合理的手-物体交互，并已成为人手建模与机器人操作中的基础性问题。然而，由于手部形态和表面建模的差异，目前仍缺乏一种统一的人手与机器人手之间的表示方式。现有方法通常依赖于接触图或稠密隐式描述符来表示交互，但这些表示往往不完整，或计算成本高且冗余。我们提出InterMASH，一种统一的几何表示方法，利用球面固定锚点建立跨具身对应关系。在每个锚点处，低阶球谐函数紧凑地编码局部手部几何、物体几何和接触信息，形成显式且可解释的标记序列。基于这种天然的标记化结构，我们引入了一种条件扩散Transformer，直接在所提出的InterMASH表示空间中运行，联合生成手部几何与接触信息，从而提升一致性和物理合理性。在大规模ShadowHand基准上，我们的方法在关键物理可行性指标上达到了与现有最先进方法相当的性能，支持多只手的联合训练，并表明利用人类抓取数据进行跨具身微调可以提升机器人抓取的成功率和多样性。项目页面可在https://inter-mash.github.io/获取。
tldr: InterMASH introduces a unified geometric representation using sphere-fixed anchors and spherical harmonics to generate hand and contact geometry for grasp synthesis, enabling cross-embodiment learning across human and robotic hands.
tldr_zh: InterMASH 提出了一种基于球面固定锚点和球谐函数的统一几何表示，用于抓取合成中的手部与接触几何生成，并支持跨形态学习。

title: WetRobo: A Reproducible Robot Kit for Coding Agents in Biological Laboratories
summary: Automating biological research requires general-purpose, reproducible robot systems that allow individual wet-lab researchers to delegate robot tasks without performing teleoperation or neural-network training. Vision-language-action policies have been proposed for general-purpose arms, but can lose performance when their operating environment changes. We therefore built WetRobo, a robot kit that can readily transfer between laboratories. It consists of one robot arm, laboratory equipment (an incubator, a reagent bottle with a cap, and a Petri dish), the existing code that moves the arm, teleoperation demonstrations of each task that we recorded, and a general AGENTS.md skill file. A biological experimentalist provides natural-language tasks without collecting local teleoperation training data or training a neural network. The coding agent observes the local laboratory and writes and executes programs, using external tools as needed for adaptation. We demonstrate use of WetRobo with OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) on three successful tasks: lifting a Petri dish lid, removing a bottle cap, and opening the incubator door, all in real-world laboratories. The coding agent achieved the cap task in both laboratories, Lab X and Lab Y, whereas a VLA fine-tuned on Lab X demonstrations succeeded there but failed to transfer to Lab Y. These results point to a practical route for laboratory robotics: instead of training a policy for each laboratory, distribute a kit and let a coding agent adapt it in each laboratory. Code, demonstrations, and the evolved programs are available at https://github.com/tsudalab/WetRobo.
summary_zh: 自动化生物学研究需要通用的、可复现的机器人系统，使个体湿实验研究人员能够委派机器人任务，而无需进行遥操作或神经网络训练。视觉-语言-动作策略已被提出用于通用机械臂，但在运行环境改变时可能损失性能。因此，我们构建了WetRobo，一个可轻松在实验室之间迁移的机器人套件。它由一个机械臂、实验室设备（一个培养箱、一个带盖的试剂瓶和一个培养皿）、驱动机械臂的现有代码、我们记录的每项任务的遥操作演示，以及一份通用的AGENTS.md技能文件组成。生物学实验人员以自然语言提供任务，无需收集本地遥操作训练数据或训练神经网络。编码智能体观察本地实验室环境，编写并执行程序，并在需要时使用外部工具进行适配。我们在真实实验室中演示了WetRobo与OpenAI Codex（gpt-5.6-sol）的联合使用，完成了三项成功任务：提起培养皿盖、拧开瓶盖和打开培养箱门。编码智能体在两个实验室（Lab X和Lab Y）中均完成了瓶盖任务，而在Lab X演示数据上微调的VLA在Lab X中成功，但未能迁移到Lab Y。这些结果表明了一条实用的实验室机器人路径：不是为每个实验室训练一个策略，而是分发套件并让编码智能体在每个实验室中进行适配。代码、演示及演化后的程序可在 https://github.com/tsudalab/WetRobo 获取。
tldr: WetRobo is a reproducible robot kit for biological laboratories where a coding agent (e.g., OpenAI Codex) writes and executes robot programs from natural-language tasks, achieving cross-laboratory transfer without per-lab policy training, outperforming a fine-tuned VLA baseline.
tldr_zh: WetRobo 是一个用于生物实验室的可复现机器人套件，编码代理（如 OpenAI Codex）根据自然语言任务编写并执行机器人程序，实现了跨实验室迁移而无需针对每个实验室训练策略，优于微调的 VLA 基线。

title: REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception
summary: Robotic systems operating in dynamic environments require visual perception that evolves continuously with the incoming sensory stream. Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, but most learning-based methods accumulate events into frames or temporal bins, introducing an integration delay that can limit fast reaction. Here we propose REACT, a fully spiking state-space model for event-driven temporal perception that processes raw events one by one, without temporal accumulation. REACT uses a complex-valued spiking neuron, C-SiLIF, whose continuous-time dynamics are driven by the physical inter-event interval, allowing its internal state to evolve at the temporal resolution of individual events. We evaluate REACT on gesture recognition and time-to-collision (TTC) estimation from full-field event streams, without a target bounding box or localization input. On EvTTC, REACT achieves a 9.59% relative TTC error with 4.6 ms end-to-end inference latency, within 0.15 percentage points of the best learned method while requiring no target prior. At the dataset's mean approach speed, this latency corresponds to only 4 cm of vehicle motion, compared with 1 m for the fastest competing learned method. REACT further supports anytime TTC prediction, zero-shot transfer to a different driving sequence, and INT8 quantization, reducing the estimated energy consumption from 18.5 to 2.8 mJ per 32,768 events. These results show that event-driven spiking state-space dynamics can provide low-latency, continuously updated temporal perception for reactive robotic systems.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中运行的机器人系统需要具备随传入感知流持续演化的视觉感知能力。事件相机提供微秒级的时间分辨率和异步传感，但大多数基于学习的方法会将事件累积为帧或时间分箱，由此引入的积分延迟可能限制快速反应能力。为此，我们提出REACT——一种用于事件驱动时间感知的全脉冲状态空间模型，它逐个处理原始事件，无需时间累积。REACT采用复值脉冲神经元C-SiLIF，其连续时间动态由物理事件间间隔驱动，使其内部状态能够以单个事件的时间分辨率演化。我们在无目标边界框或定位输入的全场事件流上评估了REACT在手势识别和碰撞时间（TTC）估计任务中的表现。在EvTTC数据集上，REACT实现了9.59%的相对TTC误差和4.6 ms的端到端推理延迟，与最优学习方法相差仅0.15个百分点，且无需目标先验信息。在数据集平均接近速度下，该延迟仅对应4 cm的车辆运动，而最快的对比学习方法对应1 m。REACT进一步支持任意时刻的TTC预测、对另一驾驶序列的零样本迁移以及INT8量化，将估计能耗从每32,768个事件18.5 mJ降低至2.8 mJ。上述结果表明，事件驱动的脉冲状态空间动力学可为反应式机器人系统提供低延迟、持续更新的时间感知能力。
tldr: REACT introduces a fully spiking state-space model with complex-valued neurons that processes event-camera data event-by-event, achieving low-latency, low-energy gesture recognition and time-to-collision estimation for reactive robotic systems.
tldr_zh: REACT 提出了一种使用复值神经元的全脉冲状态空间模型，逐事件处理事件相机数据，为响应式机器人系统实现了低延迟、低能耗的手势识别和碰撞时间估计。

title: RecMorph: Topology-Guided Spatial Recurrence for Generalized Morphology Control
summary: Generalized morphology control requires a single policy to transform information across limbs with different physical roles, coordinate whole-body motion, and remain efficient as body size grows. Existing communication mechanisms address these requirements only partially. We introduce RecMorph, a topology-guided spatial recurrent architecture that uses recurrent sequence computation to jointly perform cross-limb communication and representation transformation. A depth-first traversal converts the kinematic tree into a morphology-derived sequence, along which shared bidirectional transitions progressively transform limb information before action decoding. Residual preservation, RMS normalization, and input-dependent channel modulation stabilize this repeated spatial transformation, yielding linear token complexity at fixed model width and depth. Across five UNIMAL tasks, RecMorph achieves the strongest mean final training performance among the evaluated generalized morphology controllers and the highest measured inference throughput on FT, while generalizing to unseen variations and bodies with up to 30 limbs. We further migrate representative generalized controllers from UNIMAL benchmarks to a four-platform quadruped setting. RecMorph achieves the best macro-averaged performance under nominal and high friction, reduces nominal velocity RMSE by 43.5% relative to specialist MLPs, and one shared policy completes 40 physical Go1/Go2 trials without falls. These results show that topology-guided recurrent transformation provides an effective and efficient communication mechanism for Generalized Morphology Control and remains effective when transferred from procedural bodies to physical robot platforms. Code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/quanruirao/RecMorph.
summary_zh: 广义形态控制需要一种统一的策略，能够在具有不同物理功能的肢体间传递信息、协调全身运动，并在体型增大时保持高效性。现有通信机制仅能部分满足这些需求。我们提出了RecMorph，一种拓扑引导的空间循环架构，利用循环序列计算联合完成跨肢体通信与表示转换。通过深度优先遍历将运动学树转换为源于形态的序列，沿该序列共享的双向转换在动作解码前逐步转换肢体信息。残差保持、RMS归一化以及依赖输入的信道调制稳定了这种重复的空间转换，在固定模型宽度和深度下实现了线性令牌复杂度。在五个UNIMAL任务中，RecMorph在评估的广义形态控制器中取得了最强的平均最终训练性能，在FT任务上实现了最高的实测推理吞吐量，同时能够泛化到未见变体和多达30个肢体的身体结构。我们进一步将代表性广义控制器从UNIMAL基准迁移到四平台四足机器人场景。RecMorph在标称和高摩擦条件下均取得了最佳的宏平均性能，相较于专用MLP将标称速度RMSE降低了43.5%，且单一共享策略在40次实体Go1/Go2试验中无一摔倒。这些结果表明，拓扑引导的循环转换为广义形态控制提供了一种有效且高效的通信机制，并且在从程序化身体迁移到物理机器人平台时依然保持有效性。代码和实验资源公开于https://github.com/quanruirao/RecMorph。
tldr: RecMorph introduces a topology-guided spatial recurrent architecture for generalized morphology control in robots, using recurrent sequence computation across a depth-first traversal of the kinematic tree to achieve efficient and effective cross-limb communication, demonstrated on UNIMAL benchmarks and physical quadruped platforms like Go1/Go2.
tldr_zh: RecMorph 提出了一种拓扑引导的空间循环架构，用于机器人广义形态控制，通过对运动学树的深度优先遍历进行循环序列计算，实现高效、有效的跨肢体通信，并在 UNIMAL 基准和 Go1/Go2 等物理四足平台上得到验证。

title: UAVs Meet Embodied Intelligence: Bridging Human Intents and Flying Dynamics Via Harnessing Physical-Digital AI Agents
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) extend embodied intelligence into continuous three-dimensional space, where perception, reasoning, physical embodiment, and action are tightly coupled through flight and environmental interaction. Recent advances in foundation models, world models, and AI agents are shifting UAV autonomy from task-specific perception and control toward systems that can interpret human intent, understand open environments, reason about physical consequences, and organize complex behaviors under embodiment and flight-dynamic constraints. We characterize this emerging paradigm as UAV embodied intelligence (UAV EI) and distinguish it from its system realization, the embodied-intelligent UAV (EI UAV). To provide a unified view of the field, we introduce a 5+5 framework that describes UAV EI through five capability dimensions and EI UAVs through five architectural layers spanning physical embodiment, general cognition, embodied skills, external interaction, and system harnessing. Based on this framework, we systematically review recent progress in embodied morphology, embodied perception, world models, embodied planning, vision-language navigation, embodied manipulation, and embodied collaboration. We further identify long-horizon autonomy, predictive physical reasoning, test-time skill acquisition, and autonomous capability evolution as key challenges toward more general aerial embodied intelligence. Finally, we argue that harnessing physical-digital AI agents, through persistent coupling of digital intelligence with physical sensing, dynamics, action, and feedback, provides a system-level pathway toward adaptive and continuously evolving UAV autonomy. Project resources are available at our project website and GitHub repository.
summary_zh: 无人机将具身智能拓展至连续三维空间，在此空间中，感知、推理、物理实体与行动通过飞行及环境交互紧密耦合。近年来，基础模型、世界模型及人工智能体（AI智能体）的进展，正推动无人机自主性从面向特定任务的感知与控制，向能够理解人类意图、感知开放环境、推理物理后果，并在具身与飞行动力学约束下组织复杂行为的系统演进。我们将这一新兴范式定义为无人机具身智能（UAV EI），并将其与系统实现形式——具身智能无人机（EI UAV）相区分。为形成对该领域的统一视角，我们提出一个“5+5”框架，分别从五个能力维度描述无人机具身智能，以及从五个架构层级刻画具身智能无人机，涵盖物理实体、通用认知、具身技能、外部交互与系统驾驭。基于该框架，我们系统综述了近年来在具身形态、具身感知、世界模型、具身规划、视觉-语言导航、具身操作与具身协作方面的研究进展。进一步，我们将长期自主性、预测性物理推理、测试时技能获取及自主能力演进，识别为实现更通用空中具身智能所面临的关键挑战。最后，我们认为，通过将数字智能与物理感知、动力学、行动与反馈持续耦合，驾驭物理-数字人工智能体，为实现自适应且持续演进的无人机自主性提供了一条系统级路径。项目资源可在我们的项目网站及GitHub仓库中获取。
tldr: This paper proposes a unified framework (5+5) for UAV embodied intelligence, reviewing recent progress in perception, world models, planning, VLN, manipulation, and collaboration, and argues for physical-digital AI agents as a pathway toward adaptive autonomy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了无人机具身智能的5+5统一框架，系统综述了感知、世界模型、规划、视觉语言导航、操作与协作等进展，并主张物理-数字AI智能体是实现自适应自主的系统级路径。

title: RAFAIL: Relationship-Aware Failure Detection for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Detecting failures during execution is essential for reliable robotic manipulation. Vision-language models (VLMs) can assess task outcomes semantically but add runtime computation, whereas out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors may respond to harmless scene variations rather than failure-relevant deviations. We introduce RAFAIL, a framework for detecting execution failures during robotic manipulation. RAFAIL identifies failures by detecting anomalies in task-relevant relationships between entities, such as a gripper and an object or an object and its target. By focusing OOD detection on relevant parts of the observation, RAFAIL reduces sensitivity to task-irrelevant scene variation. Offline, a VLM annotates successful demonstrations with task progress and relationship importance, which are used to learn point-cloud-based relationship representations without relying on policy-internal features. At runtime, relationship-specific OOD detectors evaluate these representations while relationship importance and task progress are predicted without VLM inference. RAFAIL requires no failure data and achieves 73.4% balanced accuracy across three real-world robotic manipulation tasks, outperforming the strongest evaluated OOD- and uncertainty-based baselines.
summary_zh: 在执行过程中检测故障对于可靠的机器人操作至关重要。视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够从语义层面评估任务结果，但会增加运行时计算负担；而分布外（OOD）检测器则可能对无关的场景变化做出响应，而非与故障相关的偏差。我们提出了RAFAIL框架，用于在机器人操作过程中检测执行故障。RAFAIL通过检测实体之间任务相关关系中的异常来识别故障，例如夹爪与物体之间或物体与其目标之间的关系。通过将OOD检测聚焦于观测中的相关部分，RAFAIL降低了对任务无关场景变化的敏感性。在离线阶段，VLM为成功演示标注任务进度和关系重要性，用于学习基于点云的关系表示，而无需依赖策略内部特征。在运行时，关系特定的OOD检测器评估这些表示，同时在不进行VLM推理的情况下预测关系重要性和任务进度。RAFAIL不需要故障数据，在三个真实世界机器人操作任务中实现了73.4%的平衡准确率，优于所评估的最强OOD基线和基于不确定性的基线方法。
tldr: RAFAIL is a framework for detecting execution failures in robotic manipulation by using OOD detection on task-relevant relationships between entities, learned offline via VLM-annotated demonstrations and operating without runtime VLM inference. It achieves 73.4% balanced accuracy on three real-world tasks, outperforming baselines without requiring failure data.
tldr_zh: RAFAIL 是一个用于机器人操作中执行失败检测的框架，通过对任务相关实体间关系进行 OOD 检测来识别失败，利用 VLM 离线标注的学习表示，并在运行时无需 VLM 推理。在三个真实世界任务上达到 73.4% 的平衡准确率，且无需失败数据。

title: WAVE-Go: World-Model Navigation with Adaptive Execution for Wheel-Legged Robots
summary: World models can anticipate the consequences of navigation actions, but predicted action sequences may become invalid during execution, especially when wheel-legged robots encounter dynamic obstacles or change locomotion modes. We propose WAVE-Go, an image-goal navigation framework that separates world-action prediction from interruptible command execution. Its executor adaptively selects an action prefix and cancels pending commands when updated observations invalidate execution. A conditional-risk formulation specifies prefix selection under an estimated cumulative failure budget, while posture and locomotion-mode transitions require clearance, stability, and task-evidence checks. In the reported navigation evaluation, WAVE-Go achieves 74.1% in-distribution success and 63.3% dynamic out-of-distribution success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.7 and 7.7 percentage points, respectively, while reducing collisions from 4.4 to 2.9 per 100 m. Compared with interruptible fixed four-command execution, WAVE-Go raises success by 4.0 percentage points while reducing replanning frequency by 51.2% and collision rate by 6.5%. Execution ablations also show that runtime interruption improves success, collision rate, and reaction latency at the cost of additional replanning. These results support adaptive, interruptible execution as a means of balancing navigation performance and planning overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go.
summary_zh: 世界模型能够预测导航行为的后果，但在执行过程中，预测的动作序列可能会失效，尤其是当轮腿机器人遇到动态障碍物或切换运动模式时。我们提出WAVE-Go，一种图像目标导航框架，将世界动作预测与可中断的命令执行分离。其执行器自适应地选择动作前缀，并在更新后的观测使执行失效时取消待处理命令。条件风险公式在估计的累积失败预算下指定前缀选择，而姿态和运动模式切换需要间隙、稳定性和任务证据检查。在报告的导航评估中，WAVE-Go实现了74.1%的分布内成功率和63.3%的动态分布外成功率，分别超过最强基线4.7和7.7个百分点，同时将碰撞率从每100米4.4次降低到2.9次。与可中断的固定四命令执行相比，WAVE-Go将成功率提高了4.0个百分点，同时将重规划频率降低了51.2%，碰撞率降低了6.5%。执行消融实验还表明，运行时中断提高了成功率、碰撞率和反应延迟，但以增加重规划为代价。这些结果支持自适应、可中断执行作为平衡导航性能和规划开销的一种手段。代码可在https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go获取。
tldr: WAVE-Go introduces a world-model-based image-goal navigation framework for wheel-legged robots that separates prediction from interruptible execution, adaptively selecting action prefixes and canceling pending commands to improve success and reduce collisions under dynamic obstacles.
tldr_zh: WAVE-Go 提出了一种基于世界模型的轮腿机器人图像目标导航框架，将预测与可中断执行分离，通过自适应选择动作前缀和取消待执行命令，在动态障碍下提升成功率并减少碰撞。

title: OmniRisk: Omnidirectional Trajectory-Risk Learning for Agile Quadrotor Dynamic Avoidance
summary: Agile quadrotor avoidance of fast-moving obstacles requires anticipating collisions and selecting feasible maneuvers within short reaction windows. Reliable predictive avoidance remains challenging because sparse range observations do not directly reveal obstacle motion, while online trajectory optimizers either scale poorly with obstacle count or remain efficient at the expense of reliability in dense, high-speed encounters. We present OmniRisk, an omnidirectional planning framework that learns trajectory-level risk offline for efficient onboard evasion. A fixed-dimensional tensor combines LiDAR range panoramas, dynamic masks, and Cartesian surface velocities to represent geometry and motion jointly. We formulate an asymmetric risk field aligned with obstacle velocity that emphasizes approaching interactions and attenuates receding ones. Accumulating this risk along predicted relative trajectories provides dense supervision and discourages unnecessary hesitation after obstacles pass. A dual-branch circular convolutional network predicts terminal boundary states and dynamic risks for candidate primitives over an omnidirectional anchor lattice in a single forward pass, followed by selection and closed-form reconstruction of the selected candidate primitive. This formulation removes online risk accumulation along trajectories and makes risk-inference cost independent of obstacle count. OmniRisk enables efficient onboard avoidance, with real-world flights demonstrating consecutive evasive maneuvers at relative encounter speeds up to 15 m/s without fine-tuning.
